english: Tomakivka grew within the Cossack country near its namesake river. A sixteenth-century Sich stood on nearby Tomakivka Island. Later settlement expanded after the Cossack Hetmanate lost autonomy, and Tomakivka received sloboda status in 1777.
simp_chinese: 托马基夫卡发展于同名河流附近的哥萨克地区。十六世纪的塞契曾位于邻近托马基夫卡岛。哥萨克酋长国失去自治后，聚落继续扩大，并于1777年取得斯洛博达地位。

english: Tomamae faces the Sea of Japan on northern Hokkaido’s Rumoi coast. Its humid continental climate brings heavy winter snow, shaping life along this exposed northern shore.
simp_chinese: 苫前位于北海道北部留萌海岸，面向日本海。湿润大陆性气候带来冬季大雪，塑造着这片开阔北方海岸的生活。

english: Tomar grew within the walls of a Templar foundation ordered by Gualdim de Pais in the twelfth century. The succeeding Order of Christ later made the town important in the age of Henry the Navigator and Portuguese overseas expansion.
simp_chinese: 托马尔在十二世纪瓜尔丁·德派斯主持建立的圣殿骑士团院堡内兴起。继承其事业的基督骑士团，后来使城镇在航海家亨利与葡萄牙海外扩张时代具有重要地位。

english: Tomarza lies in the Kayseri region of Cappadocia and was formerly known as Dumarza. Pumpkin seeds, potatoes and the raising of sheep, goats and cattle support its agricultural landscape.
simp_chinese: 托马尔扎位于卡帕多基亚开塞利地区，旧称杜马尔扎。南瓜籽、马铃薯种植以及养羊、山羊和牛，共同构成当地农业景观。

english: Tomata lies in Mimasaka, one of the ancient provinces of the San’yōdō circuit. The circuit belonged to the Asuka-period system of five provinces and seven roads. Though its administrative form faded in medieval times, the great southern road continued to carry traffic through the Edo era.
simp_chinese: 苫田位于美作，属于古代山阳道诸国之一。该道出自飞鸟时代五畿七道体系，其行政形式在中世纪逐渐消失，但南方大道直到江户时代仍承载繁忙交通。

english: Tomatlán, whose Nahuatl name means “place of tomatoes,” lies south of Cabo Corrientes in coastal Jalisco. Spanish conquerors reached it during Holy Week in 1525 and were received with dances and feather ornaments. A sixteenth-century account also recorded a distinctive local language called Tomatec.
simp_chinese: 托马特兰位于哈利斯科海岸科连特斯角以南，纳瓦特尔语地名意为“番茄之地”。西班牙征服者于1525年圣周抵达，受到舞蹈与羽饰迎接。十六世纪记述还记录了名为托马特克的独特地方语言。

english: The Tombigbee flows south through Mississippi and Alabama, joining the Alabama River to form the Mobile. Its Choctaw-derived name means “box maker” or “coffin maker”, and the river once marked the eastern boundary of the historical Choctaw homeland.
simp_chinese: 汤比格比河向南流经密西西比与阿拉巴马，与阿拉巴马河汇成莫比尔河。名称源自乔克托语，意为“制箱者”或“制棺者”，河流曾构成乔克托历史故土的东界。

english: Tombigby takes its name from the Tombigbee River, whose waters run through Mississippi and Alabama before joining the Mobile River. The name derives from Choctaw words for a box or coffin maker. The river long marked the eastern boundary of historic Choctaw lands.
simp_chinese: 通比格比得名于通比格比河，河水流经密西西比和阿拉巴马，最终汇入莫比尔河。其名称源自乔克托语，意为箱子或棺材的制作者。这条河长期构成乔克托人历史领地的东界。

english: Tombo Point faces the Atlantic along the eastern side of Patagonia. The region contrasts sharply across the Andes, with forests, fjords and glaciers in the west and dry steppes and tablelands in the east.
simp_chinese: 通博角位于巴塔哥尼亚东侧，面向大西洋。安第斯山两侧环境差异明显，西部多森林、峡湾与冰川，东部则以干旱草原和台地为主。

english: The waters around Tombua Cape face Angola’s Namibe coast. Nearby Tômbua occupies a sheltered South Atlantic bay, whose port later became a major centre of the Angolan fishing industry.
simp_chinese: 通布阿角周围水域面向安哥拉纳米贝海岸。附近的通布阿坐落在南大西洋一处避风海湾畔，港口后来成为安哥拉渔业的重要中心。

english: Tome was one of the districts later grouped within Rikuzen Province. Rikuzen was separated from the larger Mutsu Province in 1869 and covered most of present-day Miyagi together with Kesen in Iwate. Tome thus belonged to the northeastern lands long associated with Mutsu.
simp_chinese: 登米是后来划入陆前国的郡之一。1869年，陆前从范围更大的陆奥国分出，涵盖今宫城县大部分地区及岩手的气仙。因此，登米属于长期与陆奥相联系的东北诸地。

english: Tomelloso lies in the central plain of La Mancha. Extensive vineyards dominate its fields, while the ground rises gently toward Campo de Montiel in the southeast.
simp_chinese: 托梅略索位于拉曼恰中部平原。广阔葡萄园占据田野，东南方地势逐渐抬升，通向蒙铁尔原野。

english: Tomina is a small settlement in Bolivia’s Chuquisaca region. It serves as the seat of a municipality of the same name. The 2001 census counted fewer than a thousand inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 托米纳是玻利维亚丘基萨卡地区的一处小型聚落，也是同名市镇的行政驻地。2001年人口普查记录居民不足一千人。

english: The Gulf of Tomini separates Sulawesi’s northern and eastern peninsulas. The Togian Islands lie near its centre, while the broad equatorial gulf opens eastwards to the Molucca Sea.
simp_chinese: 托米尼湾分隔苏拉威西北部与东部半岛。托吉安群岛位于中央附近，宽阔的赤道海湾向东通往摩鹿加海。

english: The Gulf of Tomini divides Sulawesi’s northern and eastern peninsulas. The Togian Islands lie near its centre, while the gulf opens eastward into the Molucca Sea.
simp_chinese: 托米尼湾分隔苏拉威西北半岛与东半岛。托吉安群岛位于海湾中部附近，东面则通向摩鹿加海。

english: Tommeginne belongs to the Indigenous linguistic heritage of northern Tasmania. Nineteenth-century word lists collected on Flinders Island preserve hundreds of words from communities described as northwestern and western tribes.
simp_chinese: 托梅金内语属于塔斯马尼亚北部的原住民语言遗产。十九世纪在弗林德斯岛采集的词表，保存了被称为西北部与西部族群的数百词语。

english: Tommot lies on the Aldan River in the Sakha Republic. The modern town was founded in 1923 as a river port supplying gold mining around Aldan.
simp_chinese: 托莫特位于萨哈共和国阿尔丹河畔。现代城镇于1923年作为河港建立，为阿尔丹附近的金矿提供补给。

english: The Tompo descends from the Elgi plateau through a deep mountain valley before joining the Aldan. This non-navigable river drains part of northeastern Siberia into the Lena basin.
simp_chinese: 通波河从埃尔吉高原下降，穿过深切山谷后汇入阿尔丹河。这条不可通航河流，将西伯利亚东北部部分地区的水流带入勒拿河流域。

english: Tomsk was founded in 1604 beside the Tom River. It became one of Siberia’s oldest Russian cities and later an important university centre.
simp_chinese: 托木斯克于1604年建于托木河畔。它成为西伯利亚最古老的俄国城市之一，后来又发展为重要大学中心。

english: Tomtor belongs to the wider Sakha country of eastern Siberia. The region has an intensely continental climate, with severe winters and comparatively warm summers.
simp_chinese: 托姆托尔属于东西伯利亚更广阔的萨哈地区。当地具有强烈的大陆性气候，冬季严寒，夏季则相对温暖。

english: Tonalá takes its name from the Nahuatl Tonallán, meaning the place where the sun rises. Its settlement brought together Zapotec foundations with Toltec and Nahua migrants, while Cocos and Tecuexes also contributed to the cultural mixture of this part of Jalisco.
simp_chinese: 托纳拉得名于纳瓦特尔语Tonallán，意为太阳升起之地。聚落以萨波特克人为基础，后来汇入托尔特克与纳瓦移民；科科人与特奎谢人也参与塑造了这片哈利斯科土地的多元文化。

english: Tonallan belongs to the Chiapas country of southern Mesoamerica. The wider cultural region supported Indigenous societies for more than three thousand years before Spanish colonization, combining lowland and highland environments.
simp_chinese: 托纳兰属于美索美洲南部的恰帕斯地区。更广阔的文化区域在西班牙殖民以前三千多年便支持着原住民社会，兼有低地和高地环境。

english: These coastal waters border the wider Mesoamerican cultural region. Its Indigenous societies shared a mosaic of cultural traits and sustained flourishing civilizations for millennia before Spanish colonization.
simp_chinese: 这片沿海水域邻接广义的中部美洲文化地区。当地原住民社会共享多种文化特征，在西班牙殖民之前已延续了数千年的繁荣文明。

english: Tonallan lies in the country of the Tonalá River, which flows north-northwest into the Gulf of Mexico. Much of the river marks the boundary between Tabasco and Veracruz. Juan de Grijalva's expedition gave it the name San Antonio in 1518.
simp_chinese: 托纳兰位于托纳拉河一带，该河向西北偏北流入墨西哥湾，大部分河段构成塔巴斯科与韦拉克鲁斯之间的边界。1518年，胡安·德·格里哈尔瓦的探险队曾将其命名为圣安东尼奥河。

english: Tonameca lies on Oaxaca’s southern coast. Its surrounding district includes the seaside communities of Mazunte, San Agustinillo and La Ventanilla.
simp_chinese: 托纳梅卡位于瓦哈卡南海岸。周边包括马孙特、圣阿古斯蒂尼约与拉文塔尼亚等海滨社群。

english: Tonami spreads across the plains of western Etchū. Dispersed farmsteads give the district a distinctive settlement pattern. During the Edo period it belonged to Kaga Domain, while the modern municipality was assembled from several older towns and villages in the twentieth century.
simp_chinese: 砺波铺展在越中国西部平原。分散农舍形成独特聚落格局。江户时代此地属于加贺藩，现代市镇则于二十世纪由数座旧城镇与村庄合并组成。

english: Tonbridge is a market town on the River Medway in Kent. It appears in the Domesday Book of 1086 as Tonebrige, reflecting an early association with a river crossing.
simp_chinese: 汤布里奇是肯特郡梅德韦河畔的一座集镇。1086年《末日审判书》以Tonebrige记录其名，反映当地早期与渡河通道的联系。

english: Tønder received trading privileges in 1243. Severe flooding struck in 1532, reaching well inside the town’s church. Dykes built later in the century cut its port off from direct access to the sea.
simp_chinese: 岑讷于1243年取得贸易特权。1532年严重洪水袭来，甚至深入镇中教堂。该世纪后期修筑的堤坝，又切断港口直接通海的联系。

english: Tondibi was the scene of the decisive Moroccan defeat of Songhai's army in the sixteenth century. Judar Pasha's forces overcame Askia Ishaq II, breaking the power of an empire weakened by succession struggles.
simp_chinese: 通迪比是十六世纪摩洛哥军队决定性击败桑海军队的战场。朱达尔帕夏战胜阿斯基亚·伊沙克二世，打破了这个已被继承纷争削弱的帝国势力。

english: Tondikandia occupies the broad dry valley of the Dallol Bosso northeast of Niamey. Its name comes from a Zarma polity formed in the early nineteenth century. Oral traditions recall earlier migrations into the district, where Zarma-speaking communities incorporated older populations.
simp_chinese: 通迪坎迪亚位于尼亚美东北、宽阔干涸的达洛尔博索谷地。名称来自十九世纪早期形成的扎尔马政体。口述传统记述更早迁入，当地扎尔马语社群吸纳了旧居民。

english: Tondo was a Tagalog and Kapampangan trading settlement on the northern Pasig delta. Recorded in the Laguna Copperplate Inscription of 900, it shared with Maynila a strong position in distributing Chinese goods through the Philippine islands.
simp_chinese: 汤都是巴石河三角洲北部的他加禄与卡潘潘甘贸易聚落。它见于900年的拉古纳铜板铭文，并与马尼拉共同在向菲律宾诸岛分销中国货物方面占据强势地位。

english: Tondzaosha belongs to the Grand Teton country of the Rocky Mountains. Glaciers carved the surrounding peaks, and streams from the mountains feed the Snake River basin. Grand Teton rises highest in its range, with a glacier sheltered below its north face.
simp_chinese: 通扎奥沙属于落基山脉大蒂顿地区。冰川雕刻周边山峰，山间溪流汇入斯内克河流域。大蒂顿为山脉最高峰，其北壁下方藏有冰川。

english: Tone belongs to Kōzuke, the Japanese province corresponding to the Gunma country. The wider province was classified as a great country but also a far country from Kyoto, and formed part of the northern network bordering Echigo, Shinano, Musashi and Shimotsuke.
simp_chinese: 利根属于日本上野国，即群马一带。更广阔的国土被列为大国，同时又是距京都较远的远国，北方邻接越后、信浓、武藏与下野的交通网络。

english: Tonekabon belongs to the historic Caspian regions of Gilan and Daylam. Its settlement developed from the remains of the older fortified city of Toneka.
simp_chinese: 托内卡邦属于里海沿岸历史上的吉兰和代拉姆地区。当地聚落由更早的托内卡要塞城遗迹发展而来。

english: Tong Lake lies within the broader high country of the Tibetan Plateau. With an average elevation above 4,500 metres, the plateau forms an immense upland north of the Himalayas, enclosed by great mountain systems.
simp_chinese: 通错位于青藏高原更广阔的高地之中。高原平均海拔超过4500米，是喜马拉雅山以北的一片广大高地，由巨大的山系环绕。

english: Tong Talun belongs to the Tarakan setting of northern Borneo. Tarakan itself is an island off Kalimantan’s eastern coast, and its later oil production gave it major strategic importance during the Pacific War.
simp_chinese: 通塔伦属于婆罗洲北部的打拉根地区。打拉根本身是加里曼丹东岸外的一座岛屿，后来发展的石油生产使其在太平洋战争中具有重要战略地位。

english: Tong’an lies on the mainland north of Xiamen in Fujian. Its old town gained the nickname Silver City because its outline was thought to resemble a silver ingot.
simp_chinese: 同安位于福建厦门以北的大陆地区。因旧城轮廓被认为形似银锭，当地获得了银城的别称。

english: The wider Lijiang region lies where the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau meets the Tibetan plateau country. Its old town preserves varied architectural traditions and a complex ancient system of water channels.
simp_chinese: 更广阔的丽江地区位于云贵高原与青藏高原地域相接处。古城保留多种建筑传统，以及复杂的古老水渠系统。

english: Tongareva is a low coral atoll in the northern Cook Islands. Its ring of islets encloses a broad lagoon, rising less than five meters above sea level.
simp_chinese: 汤加雷瓦是库克群岛北部的一座低平珊瑚环礁。环状排列的小岛围出宽阔潟湖，陆地最高处距海面不足五米。

english: The Tongareva Coast surrounds a low coral atoll in the northern Cook Islands. Its ring of islets encloses a large lagoon atop a submarine volcano, and nineteenth-century slave raids devastated its formerly numerous population.
simp_chinese: 汤加雷瓦海岸环绕库克群岛北部的一座低平珊瑚环礁。环状小岛在海底火山上围成大型潟湖，十九世纪奴隶劫掠重创了其原本众多的居民。

english: Tongatapu is a low coral-limestone island in southern Tonga. Fertile soil enriched by ash from neighbouring volcanoes covers much of the island, whose southern cliffs rise above a lower northern coast.
simp_chinese: 汤加塔布是汤加南部的一座低平珊瑚石灰岩岛。邻近火山的灰烬使大片土壤肥沃，南部海崖高出较低的北部海岸。

english: Tongatapu is a low coral-limestone island in southern Tonga. Fertile soil enriched by volcanic ash covers much of the land, while mangrove-fringed lagoons provide breeding grounds for birds and fish.
simp_chinese: 汤加塔布是汤加南部一座低矮的珊瑚石灰岩岛屿。富含火山灰的肥沃土壤覆盖大片陆地，红树林环绕的潟湖则为鸟类和鱼类提供繁殖地。

english: Tongatapu’s coastal waters lie in the Tongan island region of the South Pacific. The island is the main population centre of a kingdom whose earlier Tuʻi Tonga rulers developed a far-reaching maritime power.
simp_chinese: 汤加塔布沿岸水域位于南太平洋的汤加群岛地区。该岛是王国的主要人口中心，早期图伊汤加统治者曾建立影响深远的海上势力。

english: These ocean waters surround Tongatapu in the Polynesian island group of Tonga. The group contains 171 islands, and roughly seventy percent of its people live on Tongatapu.
simp_chinese: 这片大洋海水环绕着波利尼西亚汤加群岛中的汤加塔布岛。汤加由171座岛屿组成，约七成人口生活在汤加塔布岛。

english: Tongatapu is the principal population centre of Tonga’s long island chain. The surrounding seas spread across a far larger area than the islands’ small combined land surface.
simp_chinese: 汤加塔布是汤加漫长岛链的主要人口中心。周围海域面积远大于诸岛狭小的陆地总面积。

english: Tongatapu is the main island within Tonga's scattered Polynesian archipelago. The wider island chain extends about 800 kilometres north to south and developed from settlements associated with the Lapita culture.
simp_chinese: 汤加塔布是汤加这片分散的波利尼西亚群岛的主岛。更广阔的岛链南北延伸约八百公里，由与拉皮塔文化相关的早期聚落发展而来。

english: Tonga’s island chain extends roughly eight hundred kilometres from north to south. Tongatapu is its main centre of population within a group of 171 islands.
simp_chinese: 汤加岛链由北向南延伸约八百公里。汤加塔布岛是这一百七十一座岛屿中的主要人口中心。

english: Tongbai lies in southern Henan along the Hubei border. It forms the eastern part of the Nanyang administrative region, with a mixture of towns and rural townships.
simp_chinese: 桐柏位于河南南部、湖北边界一带。它处于南阳行政区域东部，分布着镇与乡等城乡聚落。

english: Tongcheng belongs to the Anqing country of southwestern Anhui. The wider region contains numerous Neolithic sites and became renowned as the birthplace of Huangmei opera.
simp_chinese: 桐城属于安徽西南安庆地区。广义地区拥有众多新石器时代遗址，并以黄梅戏的发源地闻名。

english: Tongcheng lies at Hubei’s southern edge near Jiangxi and Hunan. Its territory adjoins Jiangxi to the east and Hunan along its southern and western boundaries.
simp_chinese: 通城位于湖北南缘，靠近江西与湖南。县境东邻江西，南部和西部与湖南相接。

english: Tongcheon lies on Korea's eastern coast in Kangwon. Its territory passed from Goguryeo to Silla during the early kingdoms. The coastal Chongsok pavilion became renowned as one of the eight scenic sites of the Gwandong region.
simp_chinese: 通川位于朝鲜东岸江原地区。早期王国时代，领土从高句丽转入新罗。沿海丛石亭后来作为关东八景之一闻名。

english: Tongchuan forms part of Dazhou in Sichuan. Its settlements include Luojiang, Pujia and Fuxing alongside the urban districts.
simp_chinese: 通川是四川达州的一部分。当地聚落包括罗江、蒲家、复兴等城镇及城区。

english: Tongdao lies in southwestern Hunan, adjoining Guizhou and Guangxi. The county is a Dong autonomous area within the Huaihua region.
simp_chinese: 通道位于湖南西南部，邻接贵州与广西。该县是怀化地区的一处侗族自治县。

english: Tongdao belongs to the wider Guangxi country of southern China. This mountainous region is home to several languages, including Zhuang and Kam; the historical name Guangxi arose when the Song divided Guangnan into eastern and western circuits.
simp_chinese: 通道属于中国南方广义广西地区。这片山地有壮语、侗语等多种语言；广西的历史名称形成于宋代将广南划分为东西两路之时。

english: Tongdi belongs to the Qin County setting of southeastern-central Shanxi. The wider county is administered from Changzhi and includes towns such as Dingchang, Guocun and Guxian.
simp_chinese: 铜鞮属于山西中东南部的沁县地区。广义县域隶属长治，包括定昌、郭村与故县等镇。

english: Tonggu lies in western Jiangxi beside Hunan. Hakka speakers form a large majority of its population, connecting it with the wider Hakka cultural world.
simp_chinese: 铜鼓位于江西西部，毗邻湖南。客家语使用者占当地人口的大多数，使其与更广泛的客家文化世界相联系。

english: Tonggu Cape faces the coastal seas of Guangdong in South China. The broader southern region has a warm monsoon climate, and its rivers and waterways historically carried much of the traffic between settlements.
simp_chinese: 铜鼓角面向华南广东沿海水域。广大的南方地区气候温暖、深受季风影响，河流与水道在历史上承担了大量聚落间交通。

english: Tonggu lies in the wider eastern Guizhou region around Tianzhu. Today the surrounding county belongs to the Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture and adjoins Hunan on several sides.
simp_chinese: 铜鼓位于贵州东部天柱周边地区。如今所在县份隶属黔东南苗族侗族自治州，并在多个方向与湖南相邻。

english: Tongguan belongs to the wider Shaanxi country of northwestern China. The larger province encompasses the ancient capitals around Xi’an and Xianyang and is traditionally divided into northern, central and southern regions.
simp_chinese: 同官处于中国西北广义的陕西地区。整个省区包含西安与咸阳周围的古都，传统上分为陕北、关中与陕南。

english: Tōngguān belongs to the broader Yuanjiang country of Yunnan. The region takes its name from the Red River, called the Yuan River in this part of China, and occupies an important crossroads towards Southeast Asia.
simp_chinese: 通关属于云南更广阔的元江地区。当地得名于红河在中国这一段的名称元江，并处于通向东南亚的重要交通交会地区。

sources.title: Yuanjiang Hani, Yi and Dai Autonomous County

english: Tonghai occupies the fertile valley of Qilu Lake in Yunnan. Mountains enclose the basin, while the county seat lies south of the lake behind a strip of farmland.
simp_chinese: 通海位于云南杞麓湖的肥沃谷地。群山环绕湖盆，县城位于湖泊南方，中间隔着一片农田。

english: Tongjiang belongs to the wider Bazhou country of northeastern Sichuan. Ba Prefecture existed from the sixth century into the twentieth, and its name survives in modern Bazhou District of Bazhong.
simp_chinese: 通江属于四川东北部更广阔的巴州地区。巴州从六世纪延续至二十世纪，其名称保留在今巴中的巴州区。

english: Tongle is one of the towns of Leye County in northwestern Guangxi. The wider county belongs to the Baise region and is noted for its underground landscapes; in 2022, cave explorers there identified a giant sinkhole containing a hidden forest.
simp_chinese: 同乐是广西西北乐业县的城镇之一。全县属于百色地区，以地下地貌闻名；2022年，洞穴探险者在县内发现了一处内部藏有森林的巨大天坑。

english: Tongliang takes its name from a mountain in the eastern Sichuan country. Several tributaries of the Jialing cross the district, while archaeological remains attest to settlement long before its later administrative history.
simp_chinese: 铜梁得名于川东的一座山。嘉陵江多条支流流经当地，考古遗存则表明，远在后来的行政沿革之前，这里便已有人定居。

english: Tongliao lies in eastern Inner Mongolia on the lands of the former Jirem League. The regional Mongolian speech is the Khorchin dialect, and the city proper was historically called Bayitalai.
simp_chinese: 通辽位于内蒙古东部、原哲里木盟地区。当地蒙古语属于科尔沁方言，城区历史上称为白音泰赉。

english: Tongling is a river port on the Yangtze in southern Anhui. Copper and tin deposits made the area an important centre of bronze production.
simp_chinese: 铜陵是安徽南部长江沿岸的一座河港。铜矿和锡矿使当地成为重要的青铜生产中心。

english: Tonglu lies in Zhejiang under Hangzhou’s administration. The county is known as the home of founders of several major Chinese delivery companies, including STO, Yunda, YTO and ZTO.
simp_chinese: 桐庐位于浙江，隶属杭州。当地以申通、韵达、圆通与中通等多家中国大型快递企业创始人的故乡闻名。

english: Tongol Bay belongs to the broader Chilean Pacific coastal setting. Offshore, the Humboldt Current carries cold water north from southern Chile toward Peru. Nutrient-rich upwelling supports plankton and marine life, making the wider current system exceptionally productive.
simp_chinese: 通戈尔湾属于广义的智利太平洋沿岸环境。外海的洪堡洋流将寒冷海水从智利南部向秘鲁输送。富含营养的上升流供养浮游生物与海洋生命，使整个洋流系统具有极高生产力。

english: Tongren lies in eastern Guizhou, adjoining Hunan and Chongqing. Its countryside includes tobacco-growing districts and the mountainous landscapes around Fanjing Mountain.
simp_chinese: 铜仁位于贵州东部，邻接湖南与重庆。乡村拥有烟草种植区及梵净山周边山地景观。

english: Tongshan lies in the mountainous borderlands of southeastern Hubei beside Jiangxi. Much of its territory occupies the upper Fushui basin, while the Jiugong Range rises in the south.
simp_chinese: 通山位于湖北东南部毗邻江西的山地边境。县域大部占据富水上游流域，九宫山脉耸立于南部。

english: Tongue belongs to Sutherland in the northern Scottish Highlands. The regional name means southern land, reflecting the perspective of Norse rulers in Orkney and Caithness. Its later county combined the older earldom with Assynt and Strathnaver.
simp_chinese: 滕格属于苏格兰高地北部萨瑟兰。地区名称意为南方土地，反映奥克尼与凯斯内斯挪威统治者的视角。后来的郡将旧伯爵领与阿辛特、斯特拉斯纳弗合并。

english: Tongulakh is a small village in the Sakha interior. The surrounding country is known for severe winter cold and ranks among the coldest inhabited regions of the northern hemisphere.
simp_chinese: 通古拉赫是萨哈内陆的一座小村庄。周围地区以严寒冬季闻名，属于北半球最寒冷的有人居住地带之一。

english: The Tonguo rises on the northern Lena Plateau and flows toward the Vilyuy. It winds across sparsely inhabited Yakutian country, freezing in October and remaining icebound until the second half of May.
simp_chinese: 通古奥河发源于勒拿高原北侧，流向维柳伊河。它蜿蜒穿过雅库特人烟稀少的地域，10月封冻，冰期持续至翌年5月下半月。

english: Tongwancheng was the fifth-century capital of the Xiongnu-led Xia state on the southern edge of the Ordos sands. Its name means city ruling ten thousand. An imperial order in 994 called for its destruction and the removal of residents, and the once-important urban centre gradually became a ruin.
simp_chinese: 统万城是五世纪匈奴夏国的首都，位于鄂尔多斯沙地南缘，名称意为统治万邦之城。994年皇帝下令毁城迁民，昔日重要城市中心随后逐渐成为废墟。

english: The Tongwe are a Bantu-speaking people of western Tanzania. Their homeland follows the eastern shore of Lake Tanganyika around Kigoma and Uvinza.
simp_chinese: 通圭人是坦桑尼亚西部的班图语族人群。故土沿坦噶尼喀湖东岸，在基戈马与乌温扎一带展开。

english: Tongwe Ambwela belongs to the wider Mbunda country of southeastern Angola. Mbunda communities occupy lands from the Lunguevungu toward the Cuando region and include several dialect groups. Their traditions trace migrations along Zambezi tributaries and onward into Barotseland in present-day Zambia.
simp_chinese: 通圭安布韦拉属于安哥拉东南部更广阔的姆本达地区。姆本达社群分布于隆圭文古河至宽多一带，包含若干方言群体。其传统追溯沿赞比西河支流、继而进入今赞比亚巴罗策兰的迁徙。

english: Tongwei lies in central Gansu amid a loess landscape cut by steep gullies. The area has archaeological remains of early farming cultures and a long history as a fortified borderland.
simp_chinese: 通渭位于甘肃中部沟壑陡深的黄土地貌中。当地有早期农业文化的考古遗存，也长期是一片筑堡设防的边疆地区。

english: Tongxu lies in east-central Henan. It is a county administered by Kaifeng.
simp_chinese: 通许位于河南中东部。它是开封所辖的一个县。

english: Tongzhou governed part of eastern Shaanxi from the site of modern Dali. The prefecture existed intermittently from 554 until 1913. Under the Qing it became Tongzhou Fu, preserving the old regional name within a changing imperial administrative system.
simp_chinese: 同州从今大荔所在地治理陕西东部部分地区，自554至1913年间断续存在。清代升为同州府，使古老地区名称在变化的帝国行政体系中延续。

english: Toniato belongs to the eastern Ontario country adjoining the St Lawrence waterways. The wider region forms a wedge between the Ottawa River and the St Lawrence, and French explorers and fur traders entered it during the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 托尼阿托属于毗邻圣劳伦斯水系的安大略东部地区。广义地区呈楔形，介于渥太华河与圣劳伦斯河之间；法国探险者和毛皮商人在十七世纪进入这一带。

english: The Tonkawa lived in related mobile bands across Oklahoma and Texas. Recorded in northwestern Oklahoma in 1601, they later moved into Texas, combining nomadic life with some cultivation.
simp_chinese: 通卡瓦人以相互关联的流动群体生活在俄克拉何马与得克萨斯一带。1601年记录显示其位于俄克拉何马西北，后来迁入得克萨斯，游动生活中也兼有耕作。

english: Tonle Kong is the river country of the Sekong, a major Mekong tributary. Rising in central Vietnam, the river runs through southern Laos and northeastern Cambodia before joining the Tonle San near Stung Treng.
simp_chinese: 洞里公是湄公河重要支流塞公河的沿河地域。河流发源于越南中部，流经老挝南部与柬埔寨东北部，在上丁附近汇入桑河。

english: Tonle Sap is the great freshwater lake of central Cambodia and part of the Mekong system. Monsoon water produces dramatic seasonal changes in depth and extent, sustaining an exceptionally productive ecosystem.
simp_chinese: 洞里萨湖是柬埔寨中部的大型淡水湖，属于湄公河系统。季风来水使水深与面积发生显著季节变化，维持着生产力极高的生态系统。

english: Tonnerre stands on the Armançon in northern Burgundy, where two Roman roads once met at the fortified settlement of Tornodurum. It later became the seat of a county and developed vineyards by the ninth century; war brought severe destruction when the Duke of Burgundy attacked in 1414.
simp_chinese: 托内尔位于勃艮第北部阿尔芒松河畔，两条罗马道路曾在此交汇，形成名为托尔诺杜鲁姆的设防聚落。这里后来成为伯国中心，九世纪已有葡萄园；1414年勃艮第公爵来攻，城镇遭到严重破坏。

english: The waters off Tonoma belong to the northern Japanese approaches of the Sea of Japan. The archipelago separates this basin from the Pacific. Most water exchange passes through straits rather than arriving from rivers, shaping the enclosed sea’s marine conditions.
simp_chinese: 托诺马外海属于日本海靠近日本北部的入口水域。列岛将海盆与太平洋分隔。大部分海水交换经海峡发生，而非来自河流，塑造封闭海域的海洋条件。

english: Tønsberg lies near the mouth of the Oslofjord in Vestfold. Archaeology indicates settlement by the late eighth century and urban growth during the ninth. Medieval tradition regards it as one of Norway's earliest towns.
simp_chinese: 滕斯贝格位于西福尔、奥斯陆峡湾口附近。考古显示八世纪末已有人定居，九世纪逐渐城市化。中世纪传统将其视为挪威最早的城镇之一。

english: Tonshayevo lies in the Nizhny Novgorod country. Its Mari names include Pižymbal and Tuňyšo.
simp_chinese: 通沙耶沃位于下诺夫哥罗德地区。马里语名称包括皮任巴尔与通约绍。

english: The Tooele valley was traditional Goshute territory west of the mountains near the Great Salt Lake. Archaeological work at Danger Cave records human activity thousands of years before the modern town. The later city developed within this older Great Basin homeland.
simp_chinese: 图埃勒谷地位于大盐湖附近山脉以西，是戈舒特人的传统土地。丹杰洞穴的考古工作记录了现代城镇出现数千年前的人类活动。后来的城市在这片古老大盆地故土上发展。

english: Toogee belongs to Lutruwita, the island now known as Tasmania. Rising sea levels formed Bass Strait around 11,700 years ago, isolating the island's Aboriginal communities from the Australian mainland.
simp_chinese: 图吉属于今称塔斯马尼亚的鲁特鲁维塔岛。约一万一千七百年前，海平面上升形成巴斯海峡，使岛上原住民社群与澳大利亚大陆分隔。

english: Toolginburra is an alternative name for the Barada people of central Queensland. Their country follows the Connors River from Killarney towards Nebo, between coastal neighbours and inland communities farther west.
simp_chinese: 图尔金布拉是昆士兰中部巴拉达人的另一名称。传统土地沿康纳斯河从基拉尼伸向内博，介于沿海邻族与更西方的内陆社群之间。

english: These waters face the southern Australian coastal belt. The wider region contains major agricultural areas and ranges from temperate and Mediterranean environments to arid country farther inland.
simp_chinese: 这片水域面向澳大利亚南部沿海地带。更广阔的南部地区包括主要农业区，环境从温带和地中海气候区过渡到更内陆的干旱地区。

english: Toolse’s coastal castle belonged to the Teutonic Order. Completed in 1471, Tolsburg now survives as ruins in northeastern Estonia.
simp_chinese: 托尔塞的沿海城堡曾属于条顿骑士团。托尔斯堡于1471年建成，如今以遗址形式留存于爱沙尼亚东北。

english: Timpanogos country extended from Utah Lake toward the Uinta Mountains and south into Sanpete. These communities were among central Utah's principal Indigenous peoples when Mormon settlers entered the region in the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 通帕纳瓦奇地区从犹他湖伸向尤因塔山，并向南延入桑皮特。十九世纪摩门教移民进入时，这些社群是犹他中部主要的原住民族群之一。

english: Tootinaowaziibeeng belongs to the northern plains country. In the broader geographical setting, the Great Plains extend from the United States into Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba. Prairie and grassland dominate much of this expanse, which once sustained large herds of bison across the continental interior.
simp_chinese: 图蒂纳瓦齐宾属于北部平原地区。从更广阔的地理背景看，大平原由美国延伸至艾伯塔、萨斯喀彻温与曼尼托巴。草原和草地覆盖其中大片土地，昔日庞大的野牛群在这片大陆腹地繁衍。

english: Topia is a small town in the Durango country of northwestern Mexico. It serves as the seat of its namesake municipality. In 2010 the town had just over two thousand residents.
simp_chinese: 托皮亚是墨西哥西北杜兰戈地区的一座小城镇，也是同名市镇的行政驻地。2010年居民略多于两千人。

english: Topolinoye stands on the left bank of the Tompo in northeastern Siberia. The village serves as the sole inhabited centre of its rural district, far from the larger settlement of Khandyga.
simp_chinese: 托波利诺耶位于西伯利亚东北部托姆波河左岸。村庄是乡村辖区唯一的居住中心，远离规模较大的汉德加聚落。

english: Toponisw belongs to the Idaho region of western North America. The wider region has a long Indigenous history, with the Nez Percé prominent in the north and Northern and Western Shoshone peoples in the south.
simp_chinese: 托波尼斯维属于北美西部的爱达荷地区。这一广阔地区有悠久的原住民历史，北部以内兹珀斯人为主要族群之一，南部则有北肖肖尼人与西肖肖尼人。

english: Topos belongs to the Bengkulu country on southwestern Sumatra. The wider region came under Srivijaya’s influence in the eighth century and later contained several small ethnic-based kedatuan, with larger Javanese powers exercising only limited influence.
simp_chinese: 托波斯属于苏门答腊西南明古鲁地区。更广阔的区域在8世纪进入室利佛逝影响范围，后来包含多个以族群为基础的小型卡达图安政体，较大爪哇强权的影响有限。

english: Toquegua refers to communities along the Atlantic coast of Guatemala and Honduras. Their linguistic identity is debated, but colonial records associate them with several languages used for trade and prestige around the Gulf of Honduras.
simp_chinese: 托克瓜指危地马拉与洪都拉斯大西洋岸一带的社群。语言身份仍有争论，但殖民记录显示，他们使用多种在洪都拉斯湾地区具有贸易与声望作用的语言。

english: Tora belongs to the forested homeland context of the Yariguí in the Magdalena Valley. Their territory lay between the Magdalena and the Eastern Cordillera, where Carib-speaking communities lived by hunting and gathering and strongly resisted Spanish penetration.
simp_chinese: 托拉属于马格达莱纳河谷亚里吉人的森林故土背景。其土地位于马格达莱纳河与东科迪勒拉山脉之间，讲加勒比语的社群在这里狩猎、采集，并强烈抵抗西班牙人的深入。

english: Tora Bora forms part of eastern Afghanistan’s Spin Ghar range. Streams cut natural caverns through the limestone, giving the “Black Cave” complex its distinctive setting.
simp_chinese: 托拉博拉是阿富汗东部斯平加尔山脉的一部分。溪流侵蚀石灰岩形成天然洞穴，塑造了这片“黑洞”洞窟群的独特环境。

english: Tora Nju belongs to the Shangani setting of southwestern Zimbabwe. The wider Matabeleland region lies between the Limpopo and Zambezi rivers, with the Shangani separating it from the Midlands.
simp_chinese: 托拉恩朱属于津巴布韦西南部的尚加尼地域。广大马塔贝莱兰位于林波波河与赞比西河之间，尚加尼河将其与中部地区分隔。

english: Toraja communities inhabit the mountains of southern Sulawesi. Their traditional aluk faith, known as the Way of the Ancestors, forms an enduring part of a distinctive highland cultural landscape.
simp_chinese: 托拉查社群生活在苏拉威西南部山区。称为“祖先之道”的传统阿卢克信仰，是当地独特高地文化的重要组成部分。

english: Torbat-e Jam lies in Greater Khorasan near the Afghan border. Its historic shrines include the tomb of Sheikh Ahmad Jami, and local musical traditions are strongly associated with the two-stringed dotar.
simp_chinese: 托尔巴特贾姆位于阿富汗边界附近的大呼罗珊地区。历史圣陵包括谢赫艾哈迈德·贾米之墓，当地音乐传统则与两弦都塔尔琴紧密相连。

english: Tordesillas stands on the Douro in the Castilian interior. In 1494 the Spanish and Portuguese crowns signed the treaty here that divided their claims to overseas colonization along a global line.
simp_chinese: 托尔德西里亚斯位于卡斯蒂利亚内陆的杜罗河畔。1494年，西班牙与葡萄牙王室在此签订条约，以一条全球分界线划分海外殖民诉求。

english: Torgo belongs to the Aldan highland country of southern Sakha. The wider mountainous region lies between the Aldan and Uchur rivers, with Aldan and Tommot toward its north. Much remained poorly mapped until expeditions led by Yuri Bilibin and Evgeny Bobin in 1934.
simp_chinese: 托尔戈属于萨哈南部的阿尔丹高地地区。更广阔的山地位于阿尔丹河与乌丘尔河之间，阿尔丹城与托莫特位于其北部。直到1934年尤里·比利宾与叶夫根尼·博宾率队勘察前，许多地方仍缺乏详细地图。

english: Torhovytsia belongs to Podolia, the historic plateau country of southwestern Ukraine. The wider region is crossed by the Southern Buh and bordered by the Dniester, whose river routes served as important channels of trade.
simp_chinese: 托尔霍维察属于乌克兰西南部历史上的波多利亚高原地区。更广阔的地区由南布格河穿过，以德涅斯特河为界，这些河道曾是重要的贸易通路。

english: The Okinawan island waters form part of the Ryukyu chain stretching southwest from Kyushu towards Taiwan. Larger islands are generally volcanic and smaller ones coral, while heavy seasonal rain and typhoons shape the coastal environment.
simp_chinese: 冲绳岛屿水域属于自九州向西南延伸至台湾方向的琉球岛链。较大岛屿多属火山岛，小岛多为珊瑚岛；强烈的季节降雨与台风塑造着沿海环境。

english: Tormosin is a khutor in the Volgograd country of southern Russia. It serves the surrounding Tormosinovsky rural community southeast of Chernyshkovsky.
simp_chinese: 托尔莫辛是俄罗斯南部伏尔加格勒地区的一处农庄聚落。它位于切尔内什科夫斯基东南，服务于周围托尔莫辛乡村社群。

english: Torne Träsk is a long glacial lake in the Scandinavian mountains of Swedish Lapland. It drains southeast through the Torne River and is usually ice-covered from December until June.
simp_chinese: 托讷湖是瑞典拉普兰斯堪的纳维亚山地的一座狭长冰川湖。湖水经托尔讷河向东南流去，通常自十二月至六月封冻。

english: Tornea belongs to the historical northern Bothnian world. Vasterbotten is a northern Swedish province beside the Gulf of Bothnia, bordering Lapland and Norrbotten.
simp_chinese: 托尔尼奥属于历史上的波的尼亚北部地区。西博滕是瑞典北部濒临波的尼亚湾的历史省份，与拉普兰和北博滕相邻。

english: The Torngat Mountains rise between Labrador’s Atlantic coast and Ungava Bay. Their treeless summits belong to the Arctic Cordillera, while an Inuktitut name remembers these heights as a place of spirits.
simp_chinese: 托恩盖特山脉耸立于拉布拉多大西洋岸与昂加瓦湾之间。无树山峰属于北极山系，因纽特语名称将这片高地记为神灵之地。

english: Torom belongs to the Amur estuary region. The Amur Liman lies between the Eurasian mainland and Sakhalin, linking Sakhalin Gulf with the Strait of Tartary through the Nevelskoy Strait.
simp_chinese: 图穆宁属于黑龙江河口地区。黑龙江河口湾位于欧亚大陆与萨哈林岛之间，经涅韦尔斯科伊海峡连接萨哈林湾与鞑靼海峡。

english: Torope belongs to the wider Tutelo homeland above Virginia's Atlantic Fall Line. The Tutelo spoke a language related to that of the Monacan and Manahoac; pressure from English settlers and the Haudenosaunee drove migration north, and the Cayuga adopted them in 1753.
simp_chinese: 托罗佩属于弗吉尼亚大西洋瀑布线以上广义的图特洛人故土。图特洛人的语言与莫纳坎人、马纳霍阿克人相近；英国殖民者与豪德诺索尼人的压力迫使他们北迁，1753年卡尤加人接纳了他们。

english: Toropets belonged to the princes of Smolensk when chronicles first mentioned it in 1074. By the twelfth century it had princes of its own, and Alexander Nevsky married Alexandra of Polotsk here in 1239.
simp_chinese: 编年史于1074年首次提到托罗佩茨时，它属于斯摩棱斯克诸王公。十二世纪已拥有自己的王公，1239年亚历山大·涅夫斯基在此迎娶波洛茨克的亚历山德拉。

english: The Torque of the Ocean Channel belongs to the Lucayan waters around the Bahamas. The wider Caribbean region includes the Lucayan Archipelago as well as the Antilles, bringing Atlantic island banks into the same maritime world.
simp_chinese: 海洋扭矩海峡属于巴哈马周围的卢卡亚海域。更广阔的加勒比地区既包括安的列斯群岛，也包括卢卡亚群岛，将大西洋岛屿浅滩纳入同一海洋世界。

english: Torra Bay belongs to Namibia’s Skeleton Coast. Across this wider shoreline, the cold Benguela Current produces frequent dense fog while rainfall remains extremely scarce. Heavy surf made launching boats from the beach difficult, leaving shipwreck survivors facing the desert as well as the sea.
simp_chinese: 托拉湾属于纳米比亚的骷髅海岸。从整个海岸看，寒冷的本格拉海流常形成浓雾，降雨却极为稀少。猛烈拍岸浪使船只难以从海滩下水，遇难幸存者因此同时面对沙漠与大海。

english: Torra forms part of the forest country of Chocó. In the wider Colombian Pacific region, narrow coastal lowlands lie beneath dense vegetation and are backed by the Serranía de Baudó mountains.
simp_chinese: 托拉属于乔科的森林地带。在更广阔的哥伦比亚太平洋地区，狭窄的沿海低地覆盖着茂密植被，背靠包多山脉。

english: Torralba stands in the Cuenca region of Castile. The ruined castle, or Torre Alba, gave the village its name. Other landmarks include the parish church of Santo Domingo de Silos and the hermitage of Nuestra Señora de las Nieves, dated to the fifteenth or sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 托拉尔瓦位于卡斯蒂利亚的昆卡地区。村名来自现已成为遗迹的城堡Torre Alba。其他地标包括圣多明各·德西洛斯教堂，以及可追溯至十五或十六世纪的雪地圣母隐修堂。

english: Torres Lake belongs to the dry country of South Australia. Its wider setting includes some of Australia’s most arid lands and reaches south toward the Great Australian Bight. Despite this harsh landscape, evidence of Aboriginal life across the region includes ancient stone tools, mining sites and rock art.
simp_chinese: 托雷斯盐湖属于南澳大利亚的干旱地区。其所在的广大区域包括澳大利亚最干旱的一些土地，向南延伸至大澳大利亚湾。尽管环境严酷，地区各处仍保存着原住民生活的证据，包括古老石器、采矿遗址与岩画。

english: Torres Novas grew around a castle partly encircled by the Almonda River. Roman settlement survives at nearby Vila Cardílio, where mosaics and inscriptions recall an earlier age.
simp_chinese: 新托里什围绕一座部分被阿尔蒙达河环绕的城堡发展起来。附近卡尔迪利奥别墅保存着罗马聚落遗迹，马赛克与铭文见证着更早时代。

english: Torres Strait separates Cape York from New Guinea. Islander communities have lived among its islands for millennia, while the European name recalls Luís Vaz de Torres's passage through these waters in 1606.
simp_chinese: 托雷斯海峡分隔约克角与新几内亚。岛民社群已在群岛间生活数千年，欧洲名称则纪念路易斯·瓦斯·德托雷斯于1606年穿越这片水域。

english: Torres Vedras lies north of Lisbon in historical Estremadura. The town gave its name to the defensive lines of the Peninsular War. Its wider municipality combines Atlantic coastline with an agricultural hinterland.
simp_chinese: 托里什韦德拉什位于里斯本以北的历史埃斯特雷马杜拉。城镇将名字赋予半岛战争时期的防线。更广阔市镇结合了大西洋岸线与农业腹地。

english: Tórshavn stands on the eastern coast of Streymoy in the Faroe Islands. Norse settlers established their assembly at Tinganes in the ninth century, making the harbour a lasting centre of island government.
simp_chinese: 托尔斯港位于法罗群岛斯特勒姆岛东岸。北欧移民于九世纪在廷加内斯建立议会，使港口长期成为群岛政治中心。

english: Þórshöfn belongs to Iceland, the North Atlantic island on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. The wider island’s volcanic plateaus, glaciers and lava fields reflect its position astride active tectonic boundaries.
simp_chinese: 索尔斯港属于大西洋中脊上的北大西洋岛屿冰岛。整座岛屿的火山高原、冰川与熔岩地体现了其横跨活跃板块边界的位置。

english: Tortolì belonged to the giudicato of Cagliari between the tenth and thirteenth centuries. Under Spanish rule it became the head of the County of Quirra.
simp_chinese: 托尔托利在10至13世纪间属于卡利亚里司法王国。西班牙统治时期，它成为奎拉伯国的中心。

english: Tortona stands beside the Scrivia between the Po plain and the Ligurian Apennines. Roman Dertona grew at the junction of important roads, including the Via Postumia. Its strategic position made it a military station and a significant town on the routes between Genoa and the Po valley.
simp_chinese: 托尔托纳位于波河平原与利古里亚亚平宁山之间的斯克里维亚河畔。罗马的德尔托纳在波斯图米亚大道等重要道路交会处兴起。战略位置使其成为军事驻地，也是热那亚至波河谷路线上的重要城镇。

english: Tortosa stands low beside the Ebro near Catalonia’s southern coast. The Cardó massif rises to the north and the Ports mountains face it across the river.
simp_chinese: 托尔托萨位于加泰罗尼亚南部海岸附近的埃布罗河畔低地。北面耸立卡尔多山地，对岸则是波尔茨山脉。

english: Tortuga lies off northwestern Hispaniola. Spanish sailors named it for a shape resembling a turtle, but the island became especially associated with seventeenth-century buccaneers. Its position beside the Windward Passage placed it close to major Caribbean sailing routes.
simp_chinese: 托尔图加位于伊斯帕尼奥拉岛西北近海。西班牙水手因其形似海龟而命名，但岛屿尤其与十七世纪海盗相连。靠近向风海峡的位置，使它邻接加勒比主要航路。

english: Tortuga Bay lies on Santa Cruz in the Galápagos. Marine iguanas, crabs and birds inhabit its volcanic shores, while a sheltered cove supports small fish and visiting reef sharks.
simp_chinese: 托尔图加湾位于加拉帕戈斯圣克鲁斯岛。海鬣蜥、蟹类和鸟类栖居火山岩岸边，受庇护的小湾中则有小鱼与来往的礁鲨。

english: Tortuga lies off the northwestern coast of Hispaniola. In the seventeenth century its sheltered position made it a major haven for Caribbean buccaneers and privateers.
simp_chinese: 托尔图加位于伊斯帕尼奥拉岛西北岸外。十七世纪，避风的位置使其成为加勒比海盗与私掠者的重要据点。

english: Tortuguero Coast belongs to the Caribbean waters of Atlantic Central America. The Caribbean is one of the Atlantic’s major marginal seas, within an oceanic world transformed by European exploration, colonisation and the Columbian exchange after 1492.
simp_chinese: 托尔图格罗海岸属于中美洲大西洋一侧的加勒比海域。加勒比海是大西洋的主要边缘海之一，其所处海洋世界在1492年后因欧洲探险、殖民与哥伦布交换而深刻改变。

english: Tortum belongs to the historical mountain country known as Tao or Tayk. Armenian, Georgian, Roman, Persian and Byzantine rulers all shaped the region before it became part of the later Turkish political landscape.
simp_chinese: 托尔图姆属于历史上称陶或泰克的山地。亚美尼亚、格鲁吉亚、罗马、波斯与拜占庭统治者先后影响此地，后来它才成为土耳其政治版图的一部分。

english: Toruń expanded under the Teutonic Knights in 1233 and became a Hanseatic trading city. Centuries of commerce shaped its brick-built streets and churches. The town also developed a lasting reputation for gingerbread, one of its characteristic crafts.
simp_chinese: 托伦于1233年在条顿骑士团统治下扩展，后来成为汉萨商城。数世纪商业塑造了砖砌街区与教堂。城镇也因姜饼制作形成长久声誉，成为当地特色工艺之一。

english: Torzhok stands on the Tvertsa along the old route between Novgorod and Suzdal. Recorded as Novy Torg in 1139, its name means marketplace, reflecting a long commercial history alongside its tradition of goldwork embroidery.
simp_chinese: 托尔若克位于特维尔察河畔、诺夫哥罗德与苏兹达尔之间的古道上。1139年以新集市之名见于记载，地名保留商贸历史，金线刺绣也是当地传统。

english: Torzym stands on the Ilanka, a tributary of the Oder, in historical Lubusz Land. The settlement developed after the mid-thirteenth-century transfer of the region, becoming known in German as Sternberg.
simp_chinese: 托日姆位于历史卢布什地区的伊兰卡河畔，这条河是奥得河支流。十三世纪中叶地区易手后，聚落逐渐发展，德语称施滕贝格。

english: Tosa formed part of the ancient Nankaidō, together with the other three provinces of Shikoku. The circuit’s roads linked provincial capitals and connected the island by sea with Awaji and the Kii Peninsula.
simp_chinese: 土佐与四国岛上其他三国共同属于古代南海道。该道以道路连接各国国府，并经海路将岛屿与淡路和纪伊半岛相连。

english: Tosa Konoki belongs to the interior country of the Great Basin. This wider North American region is defined by enclosed drainage and dry landscapes in which successive mountain ranges separate inland basins.
simp_chinese: 托萨科诺基属于大盆地内陆地区。这片更广阔的北美区域以内流排水和干燥景观为特征，一道道山脉将内陆盆地分隔开来。

english: Tosan belongs to the wider Hwangju country of Korea’s Hwanghae region. Hwangju itself was an important Joseon-era city, whose name supplied one character of the regional name Hwanghae.
simp_chinese: 兔山属于朝鲜黄海地区广义的黄州地带。黄州城本身在朝鲜王朝时期十分重要，其名称为黄海地区名提供了一个字。

english: The Ugo country belongs to the broader Tōhoku region of northeastern Honshu. Historically this landscape was associated with Dewa and Mutsu, and its northern climate has long given the region a reputation for severe winters and relative remoteness.
simp_chinese: 羽后属于本州东北部更广的东北地区。历史上这里与出羽、陆奥相联系，北方气候使整个区域长期具有冬季严寒、较为偏远的特点。

english: Toshima occupies a plateau in the northern part of Tokyo’s urban country. The present ward was established in 1947, joining older neighborhoods within the expanding metropolis.
simp_chinese: 丰岛占据东京城区北部的一处台地。现今行政区建立于1947年，将更古老的街区纳入不断扩大的都市。

english: Tosora belongs to the southern Sulawesi world. Across the wider island, four peninsulas are separated by deep gulfs and a rugged mountain interior, so sea routes traditionally linked regions more easily than overland travel.
simp_chinese: 托索拉属于苏拉威西南部地域。整个岛屿的四条半岛由深海湾与崎岖内陆山地分隔，传统上区域联系更多依靠海路。

english: Tosse lies in the Landes country of southwestern France. The small community had just over five hundred inhabitants in 1793, before growing substantially in the modern era.
simp_chinese: 托斯位于法国西南部朗德地区。1793年小社群人口仅五百余人，现代规模则显著扩大。

english: Tost Uul belongs to Mongolia’s Gobi country. In Mongolian usage, gobi denotes desert steppe rather than completely barren desert: dry rangeland may sustain camels even where its vegetation cannot support marmots.
simp_chinese: 托斯特乌勒属于蒙古戈壁地区。蒙古语中的戈壁指荒漠草原，并非全然不毛的沙漠：干旱牧地即使植被不足以供养旱獭，仍可能养活骆驼。

english: Tosya was known under Byzantine rule as Theodosia or Doceia. The town lies in the Kastamonu country near the North Anatolian fault, whose movement caused a destructive earthquake in 1943.
simp_chinese: 托西亚在拜占庭统治下曾称狄奥多西亚或多凯亚。城镇位于卡斯塔莫努地区的北安纳托利亚断层附近，断层活动曾在1943年引发破坏性地震。

english: Toszek grew from an early fortified settlement in Upper Silesia. It became the seat of a local duchy after 1281, with the castle continuing to mark its political importance.
simp_chinese: 托谢克从上西里西亚早期设防聚落发展起来。1281年后成为一地方公国的驻地，城堡继续标志着其政治重要性。

english: Totma stands where the Pesya Denga meets the Sukhona. Mentioned in twelfth-century chronicles, it developed along the waterway used by Novgorodians to reach the northern lands and White Sea.
simp_chinese: 托季马位于佩夏坚加河汇入苏霍纳河之处。它见于12世纪编年史，沿诺夫哥罗德人前往北方地区和白海的水路发展。

english: The Totobiegosode belong to the Ayoreo world of the Gran Chaco. Ayoreo communities traditionally lived as mobile hunters and gatherers between the great rivers of Bolivia and Paraguay. Missionary settlement and forest clearance later transformed many communities’ lives.
simp_chinese: 托托比耶戈索德属于大查科的阿约雷奥世界。阿约雷奥社群传统上在玻利维亚与巴拉圭的大河之间，以流动狩猎采集为生。传教定居与森林清理后来改变了许多社群的生活。

english: Totokwan belongs to the Akimel O’odham homeland of the southwestern deserts. Their name means River People and distinguishes them from the related Desert People and Sand Dune People.
simp_chinese: 托托克万属于西南沙漠地区阿基梅尔奥奥德姆人的故土。其名称意为“河流之民”，有别于相关的“沙漠之民”和“沙丘之民”。

english: Totolapan belongs to Oaxaca in southern Mexico. The wider region is renowned for indigenous cultures, particularly the Zapotec and Mixtec, whose communities have maintained distinctive traditions amid rugged and isolating terrain.
simp_chinese: 托托拉潘属于墨西哥南部的瓦哈卡。更广阔的地区以原住民文化著称，尤其是萨波特克人与米斯特克人，其社群在崎岖而相对隔绝的地形中保留着独特传统。

english: Totoya is a horseshoe-shaped volcanic island in Fiji’s Lau archipelago. A high surrounding reef protects a deep bay, and coconut farming is an important local activity.
simp_chinese: 托托亚是斐济劳群岛中一座马蹄形火山岛。高大的外围珊瑚礁保护着深湾，椰子种植是当地重要活动。

english: Touba belongs to the wider Upper Guinea country. In its broad geographical sense, Upper Guinea extends across eastern Guinea toward northwestern Côte d’Ivoire and forms much of the upper Niger watershed. Rivers rising near Fouta Djallon link the interior with neighbouring regions.
simp_chinese: 图巴属于广义的上几内亚地区。从宽泛地理意义上说，上几内亚从几内亚东部延伸至科特迪瓦西北部，涵盖尼日尔河上游流域的大片土地。富塔贾隆附近发源的河流把内陆与邻近地区连接起来。

english: Toubui belongs to the northern island world historically called Ezo. The regional name was used for lands beyond Japan’s northeastern frontier and later especially for Hokkaido and neighbouring northern islands.
simp_chinese: 当沸属于历史上称为虾夷的北方岛屿世界。地区名称曾用于日本东北边界之外的土地，后来尤其指北海道与邻近北方岛屿。

english: Touggourt grew beside a Saharan oasis, its Berber name referring to a gateway. Date palms remain a characteristic feature of the district. The former sultanate’s town once stood behind a moat, later filled during French rule.
simp_chinese: 图古尔特在撒哈拉绿洲旁发展，柏柏尔语名称与门户有关。椰枣树仍是地区特色。旧苏丹国的城镇曾有护城壕环绕，后来在法国统治时期被填平。

english: This corridor leads into the oasis setting of Touggourt in the Algerian Sahara. Touggourt is known for its date palms and became the seat of a sultanate founded in 1414.
simp_chinese: 这条通道通向阿尔及利亚撒哈拉的图古尔特绿洲地区。图古尔特以椰枣树闻名，并成为1414年建立的苏丹国中心。

english: Toul lies between Nancy and Commercy in Lorraine. The Moselle and the later Marne–Rhine Canal give the town connections along this important inland corridor.
simp_chinese: 图勒位于洛林南锡与科梅尔西之间。摩泽尔河与后来的马恩—莱茵运河，将城镇连入这条重要内陆通道。

english: Toulnustouc belongs to the extensive Quebec region. This wider northeastern North American territory lies west of Labrador and northeast of Ontario and is the largest Canadian province by area.
simp_chinese: 图尔努斯托克属于广阔的魁北克地区。这一北美东北部区域位于拉布拉多以西、安大略东北，是加拿大面积最大的省份。

english: Toulon faces the Mediterranean in historical Provence. Shipbuilding and fishing belong to its maritime economy, alongside winemaking and other manufactures. The city also serves as the administrative capital of the Var department.
simp_chinese: 土伦位于历史普罗旺斯地区，面向地中海。造船与渔业构成海洋经济的一部分，另有酿酒与其他制造业。城市也是瓦尔省的行政首府。

english: Toulouse stands on the Garonne between the Atlantic and Mediterranean worlds. It became a Visigothic capital and later the seat of counts whose court welcomed troubadours. The Albigensian Crusade transformed its history, followed by the foundation of the Dominican order in 1215 and a university in 1229.
simp_chinese: 图卢兹位于大西洋与地中海世界之间的加龙河畔。它曾是西哥特首都，后来为图卢兹伯爵驻地，其宫廷接纳游吟诗人。阿尔比十字军改变城市历史，随后于1215年建立道明会，1229年创设大学。

english: Toumodi stands in south-central Côte d’Ivoire. The town serves as the centre of a department and sub-prefecture in the Bélier region, surrounded by numerous villages.
simp_chinese: 图莫迪位于科特迪瓦中南部。它是贝利耶地区一处省及副省区的中心，周边分布众多村落。

english: Tounouga belongs to the Sahelian belt of western Africa. In its wider setting, hot semidesert and steppe lie between the Sahara and the Sudanian savannas. The Arabic name Sahel means coast or shore, evoking the inhabited margin of the great desert.
simp_chinese: 图努加属于西非的萨赫勒地带。在更广阔环境中，炎热的半沙漠和干草原位于撒哈拉与苏丹稀树草原之间。Sahel在阿拉伯语中意为海岸或岸边，令人联想到大沙漠边缘的居住地带。

english: La Tour belongs to the wider Auvergne region of central France. The region is distinguished by volcanic hill chains, where erosion has left hardened magma forming the rounded summits called puys.
simp_chinese: 拉图尔属于法国中部更广阔的奥弗涅地区。当地以火山丘链为特色，侵蚀后留下的坚硬岩浆形成称为皮伊的圆丘。

english: The Tourinhos coastal region lies in Rio Grande do Norte in northeastern Brazil. Nearby Sao Miguel do Gostoso was founded in 1884 and was also known as Sao Miguel de Touros.
simp_chinese: 托里纽斯沿海地区位于巴西东北部北里奥格兰德。附近圣米格尔杜戈斯托苏建于一八八四年，也曾称圣米格尔德托罗斯。

english: Tournai stands on the Scheldt and ranks among the oldest urban centres of the Low Countries. It was an early Frankish capital and the birthplace of Clovis, linking its history with the rise of the Merovingian kings.
simp_chinese: 图尔奈位于斯海尔德河畔，是低地国家最古老的城市中心之一。这里曾是早期法兰克都城与克洛维的出生地，历史同墨洛温诸王的兴起紧密相连。

english: Tournon belongs to Vivarais, the historic Rhône-side country named after Viviers. At the regional scale, Vivarais once formed part of the Holy Roman Empire under a bishop-count. In 1309 it entered the Capetian realm as part of Languedoc, retaining provincial identity until 1789.
simp_chinese: 图尔农属于维瓦赖，这片罗讷河畔历史地区以维维耶得名。从区域尺度看，维瓦赖曾由兼任伯爵的主教统辖，属于神圣罗马帝国。1309年，它作为朗格多克的一部分进入卡佩王朝领地，省份身份延续至1789年。

english: Tourougoumbé lies east of Nioro du Sahel in western Mali. The town forms an urban commune within the Nioro district of the Kayes region.
simp_chinese: 图鲁贡贝位于马里西部萨赫勒尼奥罗以东。城镇是卡伊地区尼奥罗行政区的一处城市市镇。

english: Tours occupies the lower Loire country and grew from Roman Caesarodunum. Saint Martin’s cult made it a major religious centre, while royal connections and trade sustained its later prosperity. The livre tournois carried the city’s name into the monetary history of the French kingdom.
simp_chinese: 图尔位于卢瓦尔河下游地区，由罗马的凯撒罗杜努姆发展而来。圣马丁崇拜使其成为宗教中心，王室联系与贸易维持后来的繁荣。图尔里弗货币将城市名称带入法兰西王国的货币史。

english: These outer waters lie off Japan’s Tōkaidō coastal region. The Japanese island chain faces the Pacific on its eastern side, while marginal seas border it to the west and north.
simp_chinese: 这片外海位于日本东海道沿岸外侧。日本岛链东面面向太平洋，西面与北面则毗邻若干边缘海。

english: Tovisq ol belongs to the wider Alaskan country of northwestern North America. Alaska faces the Pacific to the south and Arctic seas to the north, while the Bering Strait separates it from northeastern Asia.
simp_chinese: 托维斯克奥尔属于北美西北部更广阔的阿拉斯加地区。阿拉斯加南临太平洋、北接北冰洋诸海，白令海峡则将它与亚洲东北部分隔。

english: Tovusidokado belongs to the Washoe country of the Great Basin. The wider Basin and Range landscape consists of numerous mountain chains divided by broad flat basins.
simp_chinese: 托武西多卡多属于大盆地的瓦肖地区。更广的盆岭景观由众多山链和其间宽阔平坦盆地组成。

english: Towa Panka lies in the wider Guaporé river country of Brazil and Bolivia. The river forms a long frontier and crosses the eastern Beni savannas before joining the Madeira drainage. Its basin supports hundreds of fish species, including a number found nowhere else.
simp_chinese: 托瓦潘卡位于巴西与玻利维亚更广阔的瓜波雷河地区。河流形成漫长边界，穿过贝尼稀树草原东部，归入马德拉水系。流域支撑数百种鱼类，其中一些仅见于此。

english: Towarnehiooks belongs to the wider Northern Paiute country. Across this Great Basin homeland, small bands often centred their territory on lakes or wetlands supplying fish and waterfowl. Seasonal movement and communal hunts for rabbits and pronghorn complemented these resources.
simp_chinese: 托瓦尼希乌克斯属于广义的北派尤特地区。在大盆地家园中，小型群体常围绕提供鱼类和水鸟的湖泊或湿地组织领地。季节迁徙以及共同围猎兔与叉角羚，为这些资源提供补充。

english: Towing belongs to Dar Masalit, the homeland associated with the Masalit people of western Sudan and eastern Chad. The wider region was divided among several polities before the emergence of a unified Masalit sultanate in the late nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 托温属于达尔马萨利特，即与苏丹西部和乍得东部马萨利特人相联系的故土。19世纪后期统一的马萨利特苏丹国出现以前，这一广大地区分属多个政权。

english: Towosaghy belongs to the broad Missouri country. Its wider river valleys preserve a long history of occupation, including the great earthwork-building societies of the Mississippian period and the Osage and Missouria peoples encountered by Europeans.
simp_chinese: 托沃萨吉属于广阔的密苏里地区。更广阔的河谷保存着悠久居住史，包括密西西比时期建造大型土筑工程的社会，以及欧洲人遇到的奥塞奇人和密苏里亚人。

english: Toyabe belongs to the mountainous Great Basin country of western North America. The broader region combines arid valleys with mountain ranges, and its waters gather in inland sinks and lakes rather than flowing onward to an ocean.
simp_chinese: 托亚贝属于北美西部大盆地山地区域。更广阔的地区结合了干旱谷地与山脉，水流汇入内陆洼地和湖泊，不继续流向海洋。

english: Toyal belongs to the wider Akokisa country around Galveston Bay and the lower Trinity and Sabine rivers. The Akokisa were an Atakapa people, closely related to communities near Lake Charles. Sixteenth-century Spanish accounts recorded them under the name Han.
simp_chinese: 托亚尔属于加尔维斯顿湾及特里尼蒂河、萨宾河下游的阿科基萨地区。阿科基萨人是阿塔卡帕人的一支，与查尔斯湖附近社群关系密切。十六世纪西班牙记述以Han之名提及他们。

english: Toyama Bay opens onto the Sea of Japan along Honshu’s Hokuriku coast. Winter mirages appear above its horizon. The bay is also a spawning ground for firefly squid and gives its name to a local shrimp.
simp_chinese: 富山湾在本州北陆海岸向日本海开放。冬季地平线上会出现海市蜃楼。海湾也是萤火鱿的产卵场，并将名字赋予一种当地虾类。

english: Toyoda belongs to Tōtōmi, one of Japan’s ancient provinces established under the Taihō system. The wider province’s original capital was at Mitsuke, in the area of modern Iwata, later known as a station on the Tōkaidō.
simp_chinese: 丰田属于日本在大宝律令制度下建立的古国远江。更广阔的远江国最初以今磐田一带的见付为国府，那里后来以东海道宿场闻名。

english: Toyon Arii belongs to the middle Lena country of eastern Siberia. The broader region includes Yakutia and the Central Siberian Plateau, forming part of a vast North Asian interior bounded by the Yenisei and eastern Pacific drainage divides.
simp_chinese: 托永阿里属于东西伯利亚勒拿河中游地区。整个大区域包括雅库特与中西伯利亚高原，是叶尼塞河和东部太平洋分水岭之间辽阔北亚内陆的一部分。

english: Toyota is a district in the Hiroshima region of Japan. Its modern territory contains the island town of Ōsakikamijima.
simp_chinese: 丰田是日本广岛地区的一个郡。其现代辖境包括岛屿城镇大崎上岛。

english: Toyoura lies in Nagato at the western end of Honshu. Nagato was one of the eight provinces of the San’yōdō, whose road remained an important route long after the ancient circuit system declined.
simp_chinese: 丰浦位于本州西端的长门国。长门是山阳道八国之一，古代道制衰落之后，山阳道道路仍长期是重要交通路线。

english: Tozeur lies between the salt flats of Chott el Djerid and Chott el Gharsa in southwestern Tunisia. In Roman times it was Tusuros, a town of the African province of Byzacena. An old bishopric connects the settlement with the Christian history of North Africa.
simp_chinese: 托泽尔位于突尼斯西南杰里德盐沼与盖尔萨盐沼之间。罗马时代称图苏罗斯，属于非洲拜扎凯纳行省。古老主教区将聚落与北非基督教历史相连。

english: The Grand Erg Oriental spreads across northeastern Algeria into Tunisia. Its immense dunes lie between the Atlas approaches to the north and the plateaus of Tinrhert and Tademait to the south.
simp_chinese: 东方大沙海从阿尔及利亚东北延伸至突尼斯。庞大沙丘群位于北方阿特拉斯山地边缘与南方廷赫尔特、塔德迈特台地之间。

english: Tozlan belongs to the wider Oaxaca region of southern Mexico. Rugged terrain helped preserve a rich diversity of Indigenous languages and cultures across the region, notably those of the Zapotec and Mixtec peoples. Oaxaca’s name comes from the Nahuatl Huaxyacac, associated with guaje trees around its central valley.
simp_chinese: 托斯兰属于墨西哥南部广阔的瓦哈卡地区。崎岖地形使整个地区保存了丰富多样的原住民语言与文化，尤以萨波特克和米斯特克文化著名。瓦哈卡之名源于纳瓦特尔语Huaxyacac，与中央谷地周围的银合欢树有关。

english: Tpig lies in the mountain country of Dagestan. The village serves as the administrative centre of Agulsky District and is known in the local Aghul language as Tippig.
simp_chinese: 特皮格位于达吉斯坦山地，是阿古尔区的行政中心。当地阿古尔语称村落为蒂皮格。

english: Tracadie belongs to the eastern country of New Brunswick and the wider Mi’kma’ki homeland. The region later developed a strong Acadian French culture that continues alongside English-speaking communities.
simp_chinese: 特拉卡迪属于新不伦瑞克东部与广阔的米克马克故土。这片地区后来形成了鲜明的阿卡迪亚法语文化，延续至今并与英语社群共存。

english: Tradun lies in the Ngari country of western Tibet. In this wider region, the ancient kingdom of Zhangzhung preceded Tibetan imperial rule; its sites preserve a distinctive cultural inheritance and occupy an important place in Bon religious tradition.
simp_chinese: 扎敦位于西藏西部阿里地区。在这一广阔区域，古代象雄王国先于吐蕃帝国统治；其遗址保存着独特的文化遗产，也在苯教宗教传统中占据重要位置。

english: Cape Trafalgar marks the eastern end of the Gulf of Cádiz near Gibraltar’s Atlantic approaches. The Guadalquivir, Guadiana and smaller Iberian rivers enter this gulf between southern Portugal and the Spanish coast.
simp_chinese: 特拉法加角标示加的斯湾东端，邻近直布罗陀的大西洋入口。瓜达尔基维尔、瓜迪亚纳及更小的伊比利亚河流，在葡萄牙南部与西班牙海岸之间汇入此湾。

english: Tragor belongs to Lhoka, the Tibetan country around the Yarlung valley. The wider region is regarded as a cradle of Tibetan civilization, containing early farmland, palaces and Buddhist foundations.
simp_chinese: 扎果属于雅砻河谷周围的西藏山南地区。更广阔的地区被视为西藏文明的摇篮，拥有早期农田、宫殿与佛教寺院遗址。

english: Traianopolis lies in Thrace, the historical region between the Balkan Mountains, the Aegean and the Black Sea. Thrace took its name from the ancient Thracians; its changing boundaries reflected successive Greek, Roman and later political geographies.
simp_chinese: 特拉亚诺波利斯位于巴尔干山脉、爱琴海与黑海之间的历史地区色雷斯。色雷斯得名于古代色雷斯人，其不断变化的边界反映了希腊、罗马及后世不同的政治地理格局。

english: Trakai was a medieval capital and princely residence of Lithuania. Its island castle was completed under Vytautas, while Karaim, Tatar, Lithuanian, Jewish and other communities formed the town's varied society.
simp_chinese: 特拉凯曾是立陶宛中世纪都城与王公驻地。岛上城堡在维陶塔斯时期完工，卡拉伊姆人、鞑靼人、立陶宛人、犹太人等共同形成多元城镇社会。

english: Trakamma belongs to the semidesert Karoo country of southern Africa. The wider region is defined by low rainfall and extremes of heat and cold, while its fossil-bearing rocks record ecological changes from the Permian to the Jurassic.
simp_chinese: 特拉卡马属于南部非洲半荒漠卡鲁地区。更广阔的区域以降雨稀少和冷热极端为特征，含化石岩层则记录了二叠纪至侏罗纪的生态变化。

english: Tralee grew at the head of its namesake bay beside an old route over the Slieve Mish Mountains. Anglo-Normans founded the medieval town, which became a stronghold of the earls of Desmond. It was burned in 1580 during the suppression of the Desmond rebellions.
simp_chinese: 特拉利在同名海湾尽头、跨越斯利夫米什山的古道旁发展。盎格鲁诺曼人创建中世纪城镇，后来成为德斯蒙德伯爵据点。1580年镇压德斯蒙德叛乱时，城市遭到焚毁。

english: These northern Baltic waters belong to a brackish sea enclosed by Scandinavia and the northern European plains. Limited exchange through the Danish straits distinguishes the basin from the open Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 这片波罗的海北部水域属于斯堪的纳维亚与北欧平原围合的半咸水海。经丹麦海峡进行的有限交换，使海盆与开阔大西洋有所区别。

english: Trancoso is a Portuguese town of the Beira interior, distinguished by its castle. It also preserves the memory of a substantial Jewish and converso community, whose surviving Hebrew inscriptions testify to an important part of the town’s history.
simp_chinese: 特兰科苏是葡萄牙贝拉内陆的一座城镇，以城堡为显著地标。当地还保留着规模可观的犹太人与改宗者社群记忆，留存的希伯来文铭刻见证了城镇历史的重要一面。

english: Trang belongs to the wider Malay Peninsula. This long north–south landmass contains southern Thailand and Peninsular Malaysia, with the Titiwangsa Mountains forming its backbone farther south.
simp_chinese: 董里属于更广阔的马来半岛。这片南北狭长陆地包含泰国南部与马来西亚半岛地区，更南方的蒂蒂旺沙山脉构成其脊梁。

english: Tràng An occupies cave country near Hoa Lư in northern Vietnam. Its wider landscape includes Tam Cốc and Bích Động, linking waterways, caves and the old capital’s surroundings.
simp_chinese: 长安位于越南北部华闾附近的洞穴地区。更广阔景观包括三谷与碧洞，将水道、洞穴及古都周边环境联系起来。

english: Trangan belongs to the Aru Islands in the Arafura Sea. One of the archipelago’s major islands, it shares this eastern Moluccan setting with Wokam, Kobroor, Koba and Maikoor.
simp_chinese: 特兰甘属于阿拉弗拉海中的阿鲁群岛。作为群岛主要岛屿之一，它与沃卡姆、科布罗尔、科巴及迈科尔同处马鲁古东部环境。

english: Trapani is a fishing port on western Sicily and a gateway to the Egadi Islands. Salt extraction and trade formed an important part of its historical prosperity.
simp_chinese: 特拉帕尼是西西里西部的渔港，也是通往埃加迪群岛的门户。盐的开采与贸易曾是历史繁荣的重要来源。

english: Trapessac guarded the Syrian Gates between Cilicia and inland Syria alongside Bagras. Built by the Templars in the twelfth century, it fell to Saladin in 1188 after a hard-fought siege.
simp_chinese: 特拉佩萨克与巴格拉斯共同守卫奇里乞亚通向叙利亚内陆的叙利亚门。十二世纪由圣殿骑士团修建，1188年激战围攻后落入萨拉丁之手。

english: Trasigang belongs to eastern Bhutan’s mountain country. In the wider region, political history was closely tied to Buddhist monasteries and schools, with the Drukpa Kagyu tradition established in the twelfth century.
simp_chinese: 塔西冈属于不丹东部山地。更广区域的政治历史与佛教寺院及教派密切交织，竹巴噶举传统于12世纪建立。

english: Tratalias lies in southwestern Sardinia near Carbonia. Its former cathedral of Santa Maria di Monserrato was built during the thirteenth century. Lombard bands, a rose window and a three-aisled interior make the church a notable example of Sardinian Romanesque building.
simp_chinese: 特拉塔利亚斯位于撒丁岛西南、邻近卡尔博尼亚。旧主教座堂蒙塞拉托圣母堂修建于十三世纪。伦巴第饰带、玫瑰窗与三廊内部，使教堂成为撒丁罗曼式建筑的重要实例。

english: Traunstein stands in Bavaria’s Chiemgau between the Chiemsee and Salzburg. Its historic market square and local brewing traditions reflect its role as a regional town near the Alpine foothills.
simp_chinese: 特劳恩施泰因位于巴伐利亚基姆高、基姆湖与萨尔茨堡之间。历史集市广场与本地酿酒传统，体现了它作为阿尔卑斯山麓附近地区城镇的角色。

english: The Traverse bays indent the northeastern shores of Lake Michigan, one of North America's five Great Lakes. The larger lake joins Lake Huron through the deep Straits of Mackinac, an important indigenous travel corridor and later a fur-trade route.
simp_chinese: 特拉弗斯诸湾深入密歇根湖东北岸，密歇根湖是北美五大湖之一。大湖经深邃的麦基诺水道与休伦湖相连，这条水道曾是原住民的重要通道，后来又成为毛皮贸易路线。

english: The Palawan coastal waters lie between the South China Sea and the Sulu Sea. The island chain stretches from Mindoro towards Borneo, with long Palawan Island forming the principal landmass of this southwestern Philippine archipelago.
simp_chinese: 巴拉望沿海水域位于南海与苏禄海之间。岛链从民都洛方向延伸至婆罗洲，狭长的巴拉望岛构成这片菲律宾西南部群岛的主要陆地。

english: The Treasury Islands lie south of Bougainville in the Solomon group. Mono and Stirling are separated by the deep waters of Blanche Harbour, and John Shortland recorded the islands in 1788.
simp_chinese: 特雷热里群岛位于所罗门群岛布干维尔以南。莫诺岛与斯特灵岛之间隔着布兰奇港的深水，约翰·肖特兰于1788年记录了这些岛屿。

english: Trebinje stands on the Trebišnjica in eastern Herzegovina. Its walled old quarter dates from the Ottoman eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 特雷比涅坐落于黑塞哥维那东部的特雷比什尼察河畔。有城墙围绕的老城区形成于奥斯曼统治下的18世纪。

english: Třeboň grew wealthy under the Rosenbergs in southern Bohemia. Jakub Krčín developed the surrounding fishpond system in the sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries. The Schwarzenbergs acquired the town in 1660, inheriting a landscape closely tied to managed waters.
simp_chinese: 特热邦在波希米亚南部罗森堡家族统治下繁荣。雅库布·克尔钦于十六世纪及十七世纪初发展周围鱼塘系统。施瓦岑贝格家族于1660年取得城镇，也继承了这片与人工水域紧密相连的景观。

english: Tréguier grew around a monastery founded by Saint Tudwal in the sixth century. A bishopric from the ninth century, the town also maintained a river port inland from the Breton Channel coast.
simp_chinese: 特雷吉耶围绕六世纪圣蒂德瓦尔建立的修道院发展。它自九世纪起是主教驻地，也在布列塔尼海峡岸内侧保有一座河港。

english: Mont Tremblant rises 932 meters in the Laurentian Mountains north of Montreal. The Algonquin name Manitonga Soutana means Mountain of Spirits; traditions described rumblings and movement underfoot. These associations gave rise to its French name, the trembling mountain.
simp_chinese: 特伦布朗山位于蒙特利尔以北的劳伦琴山脉，海拔932米。阿尔冈昆名称Manitonga Soutana意为精灵之山，传说描述这里发出隆隆声、脚下山体摇动；法语震颤之山的名称由此而来。

english: The Tremembé inhabited long stretches of Brazil’s northern Atlantic coast. Around the time of European contact, they were among the coastal peoples described as Tapuia, surrounded in many places by Tupi-speaking neighbours.
simp_chinese: 特雷门贝人曾居住在巴西北部绵长的大西洋海岸。欧洲人初到时，他们属于被称作塔普亚的沿海民族，许多地方都与说图皮语的邻族相接。

english: The Tremiti archipelago lies north of the Gargano Peninsula in the Adriatic. Its five islands include San Domino and San Nicola, and the group has a long history as a place of exile and imprisonment.
simp_chinese: 特雷米蒂群岛位于亚得里亚海加尔加诺半岛以北。五座岛屿包括圣多米诺与圣尼科拉，群岛长期曾被用作流放及监禁之地。

english: Trenčín's castle overlooks the Váh valley in western Slovakia. A Roman inscription cut into the rock in AD 179 records the site as Laugaricio, preserving a trace of campaigning beyond the imperial frontier.
simp_chinese: 特伦钦城堡俯瞰斯洛伐克西部瓦赫河谷。公元179年刻在岩壁上的罗马铭文称此地为劳加里基奥，保留了帝国边境之外军事活动的痕迹。

english: Terengganu is a sultanate on the eastern side of the Malay Peninsula. Its royal and administrative centre, Kuala Terengganu, stands where the Terengganu River reaches the coast.
simp_chinese: 登嘉楼是马来半岛东侧的苏丹国。王室与行政中心瓜拉登嘉楼，位于登嘉楼河抵达海岸之处。

english: Trenquelauquen belongs to the broad Pampas plains. The region’s Quechua-derived name means plain, and its grasslands were later transformed by the spread of introduced cattle, sheep and other livestock.
simp_chinese: 特伦克劳肯属于广阔潘帕斯平原。地区源于克丘亚语的名称意为平原，后来传入的牛、羊等牲畜改变了草原景观。

english: Trento stands on the Adige River in the Alpine region of Trentino. Its medieval and Renaissance centre includes the cathedral and Buonconsiglio Castle, and it hosted the Council of Trent in the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 特伦托位于特伦蒂诺阿尔卑斯地区的阿迪杰河畔。中世纪与文艺复兴时期的城中心保留主教座堂和布翁孔西利奥城堡，十六世纪特伦托会议也在此举行。

english: Trepassey Bay opens at the southeastern end of Newfoundland’s Avalon Peninsula. Trepassey, Biscay Bay and Portugal Cove South are among the communities on its shores.
simp_chinese: 特雷帕西湾在纽芬兰阿瓦隆半岛东南端展开。特雷帕西、比斯开湾与葡萄牙湾南村等社群分布在沿岸。

english: Três Pontas lies in southern Minas Gerais in Brazil. Its Portuguese name means “Three Tips”.
simp_chinese: 特雷斯蓬塔斯位于巴西米纳斯吉拉斯南部。葡萄牙语地名意为“三个尖端”。

english: The Atlantic waters around this cape border eastern Patagonia. Across the wider region, dry tablelands and steppes in the east contrast with the Andes, forests, fjords and glaciers to the west.
simp_chinese: 这个海角周围的大西洋水域濒临巴塔哥尼亚东部。在更广阔的区域内，东部干燥的台地与草原，与西部的安第斯山脉、森林、峡湾和冰川形成对照。

english: Tresivio lies east of Sondrio in the Valtellina country of Lombardy. Its seventeenth-century Black Madonna sanctuary was modelled on the Holy House basilica at Loreto.
simp_chinese: 特雷西维奥位于伦巴第瓦尔泰利纳地区松德里奥以东。十七世纪黑圣母圣所仿照洛雷托圣屋大殿而建。

english: Treuenbrietzen lies northeast of Wittenberg in Brandenburg’s Mittelmark. Its modern municipality brings together the town and a number of surrounding villages, including Bardenitz, Feldheim and Niebel.
simp_chinese: 特罗伊恩布里岑位于维滕贝格东北、勃兰登堡米特尔马克地区。现代市镇由城镇及巴尔德尼茨、费尔德海姆、尼贝尔等周边村落共同组成。

english: Treviglio arose in the early Middle Ages when three settlements united for defence. It occupies the Po plain south of Bergamo and became a centre of the Gera d’Adda country.
simp_chinese: 特雷维利奥在中世纪早期由三个聚落为防御目的合并而成。它位于贝加莫以南的波河平原，成为杰拉达达地区的中心。

english: Treviso is a town of the Veneto in northern Italy. Venetian walls enclose its historic centre, preserving the fortified outline of the older settlement.
simp_chinese: 特雷维索是意大利北部威尼托地区的城镇。威尼斯时期城墙围住历史中心，保留着较早聚落的设防轮廓。

english: Trévoux occupies a steep bank of the Saône north of Lyon. Its frontier position helped secure unusual political privileges. Bought by the Bourbons in 1402, it became the capital of the Dombes, with a mint, river tolls and fortifications supporting its importance.
simp_chinese: 特雷武占据里昂以北索恩河陡岸。边界位置帮助它取得特殊政治特权。1402年波旁家族购入后，它成为栋布首府，铸币厂、河税与城防共同支撑地位。

english: Trgovište developed as a medieval market below the fortress of Stari Ras. A newer market grew to the east during the fifteenth century, becoming Novi Pazar, while the older site retained the name Old Trgovište.
simp_chinese: 特尔戈维什泰发展为斯塔里拉斯要塞下方的中世纪市场。15世纪更东面又兴起新市场，后来成为新帕扎尔，旧址则保留旧特尔戈维什泰之名。

english: The Gulf of Tribugá opens on Colombia’s Pacific coast in Chocó. Mangroves line the humid tropical shore, humpback whales breed in its waters, and Emberá communities inhabit nearby river basins; Cabo Corrientes marks the gulf’s southern end.
simp_chinese: 特里布加湾位于哥伦比亚乔科的太平洋海岸。潮湿热带海岸分布红树林，座头鲸在湾内水域繁殖，邻近河流流域生活着恩贝拉社群，科连特斯角标志着海湾南端。

english: Trier began as Roman Augusta Treverorum in the Moselle valley. An imperial capital during the Tetrarchy, it later became the seat of an archbishop whose lands reached toward the Rhine and whose electoral vote helped choose the Holy Roman Emperor.
simp_chinese: 特里尔起源于摩泽尔河谷的罗马奥古斯塔特雷维罗鲁姆。它在四帝共治时期曾为帝国都城，后来成为大主教驻地；主教领地延向莱茵河，其选帝票也参与决定神圣罗马皇帝。

english: Trieste occupies the head of its Adriatic gulf beneath a karst hinterland. Under Habsburg rule from 1382 to 1918, it developed into the monarchy’s principal seaport and a prosperous Mediterranean trading center.
simp_chinese: 的里雅斯特位于亚得里亚海同名湾顶，背靠喀斯特腹地。1382至1918年间归哈布斯堡统治，发展为王朝主要海港及繁荣的地中海贸易中心。

english: Trigu belongs to Lhoka in southeastern Tibet. The Yarlung Valley region is traditionally regarded as a birthplace of Tibetan civilization and contains Tibet's earliest palace and first Buddhist monastery.
simp_chinese: 赤古属于西藏东南部的山南地区。雅砻河谷传统上被视为西藏文明发源地，拥有西藏最早的宫殿与第一座佛教寺院。

english: Trikala straddles the Lithaios in northwestern Thessaly. Its name preserves ancient Trikka, while the Pindus mountains and Meteora lie nearby.
simp_chinese: 特里卡拉跨越色萨利西北部的利泰奥斯河。名称保留着古城特里卡的记忆，附近则是品都斯山脉与迈泰奥拉。

english: Trim is one of the towns of County Meath in eastern Ireland. The wider county belongs to Leinster and reaches the Irish Sea along a narrow coast between the Boyne and Delvin rivers.
simp_chinese: 特里姆是爱尔兰东部米斯郡的城镇之一。更广阔的米斯郡属于伦斯特，通过博因河与德尔文河之间一段狭窄海岸接触爱尔兰海。

english: Trincomalee occupies a peninsula dividing a great natural harbour on Sri Lanka’s eastern coast. The Koneswaram temple helped shape the town and its historic Tamil name. A long role in Tamil-speaking religious and cultural life accompanied the port’s connections with other parts of the island.
simp_chinese: 亭可马里占据斯里兰卡东岸一座分隔天然大港的半岛。科内斯瓦拉姆神庙帮助塑造城镇及其历史泰米尔名称。港口与岛内其他地区的联系，伴随着它在泰米尔语宗教文化生活中的长期地位。

english: Trinidad lies just off Venezuela's northeastern coast on the South American continental shelf. Its Arawakan name Iere meant land of the hummingbird, before Columbus gave it the name Trinidad in 1498.
simp_chinese: 特立尼达位于委内瑞拉东北岸近海的南美洲大陆架上。其阿拉瓦克语旧名伊埃雷意为“蜂鸟之地”，哥伦布于一四九八年将其命名为特立尼达。

english: Trinity’s coastal waters belong to the northern Gulf of Mexico. Sediment forms much of the basin floor, while narrow connections lead outward toward the Atlantic and Caribbean.
simp_chinese: 特里尼蒂沿岸水域属于墨西哥湾北部。海盆底部大多由沉积物组成，狭窄通道则向外连接大西洋和加勒比海。

english: Tripoli gave its name to the historic region of Tripolitania in northwestern Libya. The wider country was shaped by Carthaginian and Roman rule, then passed through Vandal and Byzantine control before becoming part of the Islamic lands of Ifriqiya.
simp_chinese: 的黎波里使利比亚西北部的历史地区得名的黎波里塔尼亚。整个地区受迦太基与罗马统治塑造，随后经历汪达尔和拜占庭控制，后来成为伊斯兰易弗里基叶的一部分。

english: Tripoli overlooks the eastern Mediterranean on the coast of Lebanon. Under Persian rule it became a center of a confederation linking Sidon, Tyre and Arados; Hellenistic rulers used it as a naval shipyard. Its later monuments include the Mansouri Great Mosque and a great crusader citadel.
simp_chinese: 的黎波里面向黎巴嫩沿岸的东地中海。波斯统治时期，它成为连接西顿、推罗与阿拉多斯的联盟中心；希腊化时代的统治者将其用作海军造船基地。后世遗迹包括曼苏里大清真寺和宏伟的十字军城堡。

english: Tripolitsa lies in the central Peloponnese in the region of Arcadia. Medieval forms of its name included Drobolitsa and Dorboglitza.
simp_chinese: 特里波利察位于伯罗奔尼撒半岛中部的阿卡迪亚地区。中世纪的名称形式包括德罗博利察和多尔博格利察。

english: These coastal waters surround the remote volcanic island of Tristan da Cunha in the South Atlantic. The wider island group includes Gough, Inaccessible and the Nightingale Islands, separated from the continents by vast stretches of ocean.
simp_chinese: 这片沿岸水域环绕南大西洋偏远的特里斯坦－达库尼亚火山岛。广义岛群还包括戈夫岛、伊纳克塞瑟布尔岛和南丁格尔群岛，与各大陆之间隔着广阔洋面。

english: Tristan da Cunha is a remote volcanic island in the South Atlantic. Portuguese navigator Tristão da Cunha sighted it in 1506, but rough seas prevented his expedition from landing.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚是南大西洋一座偏远火山岛。葡萄牙航海家特里斯唐·达库尼亚于1506年望见该岛，但风浪使船队无法登陆。

english: These waters surround Tristan da Cunha, a remote volcanic island group in the South Atlantic. Portuguese navigator Tristão da Cunha first recorded the islands in 1506, and the main island later became an exceptionally isolated inhabited community.
simp_chinese: 这片海域环绕南大西洋偏远的特里斯坦-达库尼亚火山群岛。葡萄牙航海家特里斯唐·达库尼亚于1506年首次记录诸岛，主岛后来成为极为孤立的有人定居社群。

english: These coastal waters surround the remote volcanic island group of Tristan da Cunha. Portuguese navigator Tristão da Cunha recorded the islands in 1506, but rough seas prevented a landing.
simp_chinese: 这片沿岸水域环绕偏远的特里斯坦-达库尼亚火山群岛。葡萄牙航海家特里斯唐·达库尼亚于1506年记录了这些岛屿，但风浪阻止了登陆。

english: These South Atlantic waters surround the remote volcanic island group of Tristan da Cunha. The group also includes Gough, Inaccessible and the smaller Nightingale Islands.
simp_chinese: 这片南大西洋海水环绕偏远的特里斯坦达库尼亚火山群岛。群岛还包括戈夫岛、伊纳克塞瑟布尔岛和较小的南丁格尔诸岛。

english: Tristan da Cunha rises in the remote South Atlantic as a group of volcanic islands. Gough, Inaccessible and the Nightingale Islands accompany the main inhabited island.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚作为火山群岛分布于偏远南大西洋。戈夫岛、伊纳克塞瑟布尔岛与南丁格尔群岛伴随主要有人岛。

english: Tristan da Cunha is a remote volcanic island group in the South Atlantic. Besides the main island, the group includes Inaccessible Island, Gough and the smaller Nightingale Islands.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦达库尼亚是南大西洋中偏远的火山群岛。除主岛外，群岛还包括伊纳克塞瑟布尔岛、戈夫岛和较小的南丁格尔群岛。

english: Tristan da Cunha is a remote volcanic island group in the South Atlantic. Its outlying islands include Gough, Inaccessible and the Nightingale Islands.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚是南大西洋上一组偏远的火山岛。其外围岛屿包括戈夫岛、伊纳克塞瑟布尔岛和南丁格尔群岛。

english: Tristan da Cunha’s coastal waters surround remote volcanic islands in the South Atlantic. The group includes the inhabited main island, the Nightingale Islands and the wildlife reserves of Gough and Inaccessible, with sea travel providing its essential connection to the outside world.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚沿海水域环绕着南大西洋偏远的火山群岛。岛群包括有人居住的主岛、南丁格尔群岛，以及戈夫岛和伊纳克塞瑟布尔岛野生生物保护区，海路是与外界相连的重要通道。

english: These South Atlantic waters surround the remote volcanic islands of Tristan da Cunha. The island group includes Tristan itself, Gough, Inaccessible and the smaller Nightingale Islands, separated from continental shores by long sea passages.
simp_chinese: 这片南大西洋水域环绕偏远的特里斯坦-达库尼亚火山群岛。岛群包括特里斯坦主岛、戈夫岛、伊纳克塞瑟布尔岛及较小的南丁格尔群岛，与大陆海岸之间是漫长海程。

english: Tristan da Cunha rises from the South Atlantic as a remote volcanic island group. Its main inhabited island is accompanied by Gough, Inaccessible and the smaller Nightingale Islands, with access to Tristan dependent on sea travel.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦达库尼亚是从南大西洋中升起的一组偏远火山岛。主要有人居住的岛屿周围还有戈夫岛、伊纳克塞瑟布尔岛和较小的南丁格尔群岛，前往特里斯坦依赖海上交通。

english: The Tristan offshore sea lies around one of the world's most isolated inhabited island groups. Volcanic Tristan and the surrounding islands stand in the South Atlantic, and ships remain the only means of reaching the main island.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦外海环绕世界最偏远的有人居住岛群之一。火山形成的特里斯坦及周边岛屿位于南大西洋，船舶仍是抵达主岛的唯一方式。

english: The Tristan da Cunha seas surround volcanic islands including Tristan, Inaccessible and the Nightingale group. The inhabited main island has no airstrip, so all travel to and from this remote Atlantic outpost depends on ships.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦-达库尼亚海域环绕特里斯坦岛、伊纳克塞瑟布尔岛与南丁格尔群岛等火山岛。有人定居的主岛没有机场跑道，这一偏远大西洋据点的对外交通完全依靠船舶。

english: The Tristan coastal region lies deep in the South Atlantic. Its wider island group includes Gough, Inaccessible and the Nightingale Islands, with the inhabited main island dependent on ships for access.
simp_chinese: 特里斯坦沿岸地区位于南大西洋深处。整个岛群包括戈夫岛、伊纳克塞瑟布尔岛和南丁格尔群岛，有人居住的主岛依赖船只与外界往来。

english: Triste Gulf belongs to the Venezuelan margin of the Caribbean. The wider region encompasses northern South American coasts alongside the Antilles and surrounding seas.
simp_chinese: 特里斯特湾属于加勒比的委内瑞拉一侧。更广阔的区域包括南美洲北部海岸，以及安的列斯群岛和周围海域。

english: Trivento is a small episcopal town in the Molise country northwest of Campobasso. Its cathedral is dedicated to Saints Nazarius, Celsus and Victor and serves as the seat of the local Catholic diocese.
simp_chinese: 特里文托是坎波巴索西北方莫利塞地区的一座主教城镇。主教座堂敬奉圣纳扎里乌斯、切尔苏斯与维克托，是当地天主教教区的驻地。

english: Trnava stands on the Trnávka in western Slovakia. Its name recalls thorn bushes along the stream, while the many churches within its walls earned it the epithet Little Rome. The archbishopric established here in 1541 strengthened the town’s ecclesiastical role during the early modern period.
simp_chinese: 特尔纳瓦位于斯洛伐克西部特尔纳夫卡河畔。地名使人联想到溪岸荆棘，城墙内众多教堂则带来“小罗马”之称。1541年迁设于此的总主教区，强化了近代早期的宗教地位。

english: Trøgstad grew from a parish named for an old farm in Norway’s Østfold country. Its local communities included Skjønhaug, Havnås and Båstad. A reputation for skilled blacksmiths survived into the modern coat of arms, which uses an anvil to recall ironworking traditions.
simp_chinese: 特勒格斯塔起源于挪威东福尔一处以古农场命名的教区，地方社群包括舍恩豪格、哈夫诺斯与博斯塔。精良铁匠的声誉延续到现代纹章，以铁砧纪念冶铁工艺传统。

english: Troitsk lies in the Chelyabinsk country east of the Urals. It shares its name with several other Russian settlements.
simp_chinese: 特罗伊茨克位于乌拉尔山以东的车里雅宾斯克地区。俄罗斯还有数座同名聚落。

english: Troitsko-Pechorsk stands on the Pechora in the Komi country. The modern settlement serves as the centre of its surrounding district, with the nearby village of Bolshaya Soyva included in its local territory.
simp_chinese: 特罗伊茨科伯朝拉位于科米地区的伯朝拉河畔。现代聚落是周围辖区的中心，邻近大索伊瓦村也属于其地方辖域。

english: Troitskoye-Kuroedovo belongs to the wider Samara country of the middle Volga. Samara stands where the Samara River meets the Volga, whose waters have long shaped the life of the region.
simp_chinese: 特罗伊茨科耶库罗耶多沃属于伏尔加河中游广义的萨马拉地区。萨马拉位于萨马拉河与伏尔加河交汇处，河流长期塑造着这一地区的生活。

english: Troitskoye Na Shchigrakh belongs to the Kursk region. In the wider region, Kursk was an early stronghold of the Kievan princes on their southeastern frontier and appears in written records from 1032.
simp_chinese: 什奇格雷三一镇属于库尔斯克地区。在更广阔的地区，库尔斯克是基辅诸王公东南边疆的早期据点，1032年已见于文字记载。

english: Trollaborg belongs to Småland in southern Sweden. The broader province takes its name from the many small historical lands that composed it, and its forested high plain contains numerous lakes and bogs.
simp_chinese: 特罗拉堡属于瑞典南部的斯莫兰。更广阔的省区因组成它的众多历史小地域而得名，其森林高平原分布着众多湖泊与泥沼。

english: Trom-Yegan belongs to the Ob river country around Surgut. The wider regional centre began as a Russian fortress in 1594 and became an important point in the subsequent development of Siberia.
simp_chinese: 特罗姆‑叶甘属于苏尔古特周围的鄂毕河地区。更广阔区域的中心始于1594年建立的俄罗斯堡垒，后来成为西伯利亚开发的重要节点。

english: Tromge belongs to the Derge country of Kham. The wider kingdom was a political and religious centre of eastern Tibet, and its capital was renowned for a three-storey printing house. Derge’s name means “land of mercy”, reflecting its place in Tibetan cultural memory.
simp_chinese: 仲格属于康区德格地域。广大王国曾是东部藏区的政治与宗教中心，其都城以三层印经院闻名。德格之名意为“善地”，体现了它在藏地文化记忆中的地位。

english: Troms occupies northern Norwegian country entirely beyond the Arctic Circle. The Norwegian Sea lies to its west, while inland frontiers meet Sweden and Finland.
simp_chinese: 特罗姆斯位于挪威北部，完全处于北极圈以北。西临挪威海，内陆边界则与瑞典和芬兰相接。

english: Trondenes occupies a peninsula in Vågsfjorden near Harstad. Its medieval church served as a religious centre of northern Norway, while burial mounds and older discoveries testify to a much longer history of settlement.
simp_chinese: 特龙德内斯占据哈尔斯塔附近沃格斯峡湾的一处半岛。中世纪教堂曾是挪威北部宗教中心，墓丘与年代更早的发现则显示了更悠久的定居历史。

english: Trondheim Fjord reaches inland from the Norwegian Sea through Trøndelag. Its deep main channel and islands provide varied harbours, while most of the central fjord remains ice-free throughout the year. Trondheim, Levanger and Steinkjer grew along its shores.
simp_chinese: 特隆赫姆峡湾自挪威海深入特伦德拉格。深邃主航道与岛屿提供多样港湾，中央大部分水域终年不冻。特隆赫姆、莱旺厄尔与斯泰恩谢尔沿岸发展。

english: Trongsa’s first temple was founded in 1543 by the Drukpa lama Ngagi Wangchuck. Its great dzong, built in 1644, later became a seat of Wangchuck power in central Bhutan.
simp_chinese: 通萨最早的寺庙由竹巴喇嘛阿旺旺楚于1543年创建。1644年兴建的大宗堡，后来成为旺楚家族在不丹中部的权力中心。

english: Tronka'chua lies in the wider Athabasca country. Before European colonisation, Cree, Sekani and several other peoples hunted and fished along the river. From the late eighteenth century, the Athabasca, Clearwater and Methye Portage linked northern waterways with the Great Lakes fur trade.
simp_chinese: 特龙卡丘阿位于更广阔的阿萨巴斯卡地区。欧洲殖民开始前，克里人、塞卡尼人及其他族群沿河渔猎。十八世纪后期，阿萨巴斯卡河、克利尔沃特河和梅西陆运道将北方水道与五大湖皮毛贸易联系起来。

english: Tropu belongs to the broad Tibetan highland world. Much of Tibet occupies the world’s highest plateau region, whose mountain barriers and upland landscapes form the homeland of the Tibetan people.
simp_chinese: 绰浦属于广阔的西藏高地。西藏的大部分地区位于世界最高的高原区域，山脉屏障和高地景观构成藏族人民的家园。

english: Troshovo belongs to the wider Bezhetsk country in eastern Tver. Its rivers drain toward the Volga, chiefly through the Mologa system. The Mologa enters this region from the west and turns north, passing the regional center of Bezhetsk.
simp_chinese: 特罗绍沃属于特维尔东部更广阔的别热茨克地区。当地河流通过莫洛加河等水系流向伏尔加河。莫洛加河从西方进入这片地区，经过中心城镇别热茨克后转向北流。

english: Trotsang belongs to the eastern Tibetan country of Kham. The wider region combines forested mountains, grasslands and river valleys, historically sustaining local warrior kingdoms and Buddhist monastic centres.
simp_chinese: 措仓属于藏东的康区。更广阔的地区兼有森林山地、草地与河谷，历史上支撑地方武士王国与佛教寺院中心。

english: Trout Lake, or Sambaa K’e, lies in the Dehcho country of Canada’s Northwest Territories. Its South Slavey name means place of trout. The lake receives several rivers and empties through Trout River toward the Mackenzie, while its fish include lake trout, pike, walleye and Arctic grayling.
simp_chinese: 鳟鱼湖又称桑巴凯，位于加拿大西北地区的德乔。其南斯拉维语名称意为鳟鱼之地。多条河流注入湖中，湖水再经鳟鱼河流向马更些河；湖鱼包括湖鳟、狗鱼、梭鲈与北极茴鱼。
