english: Trowbridge stands on the Biss in western Wiltshire. Woollen cloth production made it a leading manufacturing town by the late eighteenth century. The Kennet and Avon Canal brought coal from Somerset, enabling steam power to transform the mills of this market settlement.
simp_chinese: 特罗布里奇位于威尔特郡西部比斯河畔。到十八世纪末，毛呢生产使其成为领先制造业城镇。肯尼特埃文运河从萨默塞特运入煤炭，让蒸汽动力改变这座集镇的纺织厂。

english: Trowulan preserves an extensive archaeological landscape in eastern Java. The site is commonly identified with the Majapahit capital described in the fourteenth-century Nagarakretagama and later Chinese accounts.
simp_chinese: 特罗武兰保存着爪哇东部一片广阔考古景观。遗址通常被认作十四世纪《爪哇史颂》及较晚中国记述中的满者伯夷都城。

english: Troyes stands on the Seine in the Champagne country. Its Roman predecessor was known as Augustobona Tricassium, giving the later town an ancient urban foundation.
simp_chinese: 特鲁瓦位于香槟地区的塞纳河畔。罗马时代前身称奥古斯托博纳特里卡西乌姆，为后来的城镇奠定了古代城市基础。

english: Trubchevsk was an old Severian town recorded in twelfth-century chronicles as Trubetsk. The Tale of Igor’s Campaign also names the settlement, placing it within the literary geography of medieval Rus.
simp_chinese: 特鲁布切夫斯克是古老的谢韦里亚城镇，十二世纪编年史称其为特鲁别茨克。《伊戈尔远征记》也提及此地，使它进入中世纪罗斯的文学地理。

english: Trufany belongs to the broader Smolensk country along the routes of western Russia. Smolensk, the regional centre, stood on the Varangian-Greek trade route and later became a contested gateway toward Moscow.
simp_chinese: 特鲁法内处于俄罗斯西部交通线上的广义斯摩棱斯克地区。区域中心斯摩棱斯克位于瓦良格—希腊商路上，后来成为通往莫斯科的争夺要地。

english: Trujillo belongs to Extremadura in western Iberia. The larger region borders Portugal and is crossed from east to west by the Tagus and Guadiana river systems.
simp_chinese: 特鲁希略属于伊比利亚西部的埃斯特雷马杜拉。整个地区西接葡萄牙，塔霍河与瓜迪亚纳河水系自东向西流贯。

english: Truká country is associated with the Ilha da Assunção islands in the São Francisco River near Cabrobó in northeastern Brazil. The people preserve a distinct identity, though their earlier language is considered extinct and remains unattested in surviving records.
simp_chinese: 特鲁卡地区与巴西东北部卡布罗博附近圣弗朗西斯科河中的阿松桑群岛相联系。当地人保有鲜明的族群身份，但早期语言被认为已经消亡，现存记录没有留下足以见证其面貌的资料。

english: Truku belongs to the wider island landscape of Taiwan, formerly known as Formosa. Mountain ranges dominate the eastern two-thirds of the island, while broad plains lie to the west.
simp_chinese: 太鲁阁属于旧称福尔摩沙的台湾岛。岛屿东部约三分之二以山脉为主，西部则分布着广阔平原。

english: Truro grew through its port and the Cornish tin trade. It became a stannary town and received city status in 1877 after a new diocese was established.
simp_chinese: 特鲁罗凭港口与康沃尔锡贸易发展。它成为锡业管理城镇，并在新教区设立后于1877年获得城市地位。

english: Trusan belongs to northern Borneo, an island whose long-inhabited tropical lands lie at the centre of maritime Southeast Asia. The wider island once formed part of Sundaland, connected with mainland Asia before rising seas isolated it after the last glacial period.
simp_chinese: 特鲁桑属于婆罗洲北部，这座热带岛屿位于海洋东南亚中心，人类居住历史悠久。更广阔的岛屿曾属巽他古陆，与亚洲大陆相连，末次冰期后海平面上升才使其隔绝。

english: Tryavna lies in a valley on the Balkan range’s northern slopes. Medieval records reach back to the twelfth century, while textiles and National Revival architecture later became characteristic of the town.
simp_chinese: 特里亚夫纳位于巴尔干山脉北坡谷地。中世纪记录可追溯至十二世纪，纺织业与民族复兴时期建筑后来成为城镇特色。

english: Trysil belongs to Norway’s wooded Østerdalen country, with its center at Innbygda. Its parish became a civil municipality in 1838, linking dispersed villages within a large inland territory.
simp_chinese: 特吕西尔属于挪威森林覆盖的厄斯特谷地区，中心设在因比格达。同名教区于1838年成为民政市镇，将广大内陆地域中分散的村落连接起来。

english: Trzebnica grew as a religious and trading centre in Lower Silesia. The sanctuary of Saint Hedwig became a regional pilgrimage destination and a burial place associated with Polish ruling families.
simp_chinese: 切布尼察作为下西里西亚宗教与贸易中心成长。圣雅德维加圣所成为地区朝圣地，也是与波兰统治家族有关的安葬地。

english: Trzemeszno developed from a defended settlement into a market on the route linking Greater Poland with northern Masovia and Pomerelia. Augustinian canons became its owners in the twelfth century. The town’s position beside Lake Popielewskie joined monastic authority with a useful place of exchange.
simp_chinese: 切梅什诺从设防聚落发展为连接大波兰、马佐夫舍北部与东波美拉尼亚路线上的市场。十二世纪奥古斯丁会教士成为所有者。波皮耶莱夫湖畔的位置，使修会权威与便利交换地点相结合。

english: Ts Il Kaz Koh belongs to the country of the Wet’suwet’en in interior British Columbia. Their wider homeland includes the Bulkley River and the country around Burns, Broman and Francois lakes, and their language belongs to the Athabaskan family.
simp_chinese: 齐尔卡兹科属于不列颠哥伦比亚内陆韦特苏维滕人的地域。其故土包括巴尔克利河以及伯恩斯湖、布罗曼湖和弗朗索瓦湖一带，语言属于阿萨巴斯卡语系。

english: Tsa’tinne belongs to the northeastern interior country of British Columbia. On the scale of the wider province, the Rocky Mountains mark the eastern side of a landscape whose relief ranges from forested mountains to dry inland plains.
simp_chinese: 察廷尼属于不列颠哥伦比亚东北内陆地区。从更大省域尺度看，落基山脉构成东部边缘，其地貌从森林山地延伸至干燥的内陆平原。

english: Tsáchila communities live near the foot of Ecuador’s Andes. Several settlements cluster around Santo Domingo, preserving a shared Indigenous identity between the highlands and Pacific lowlands.
simp_chinese: 察奇拉社群生活在厄瓜多尔安第斯山麓。数个聚落集中于圣多明各周围，在高地与太平洋低地之间保留共同原住民身份。

english: Tsagaan lies in the Torey lake country near the Mongolian frontier. The wider basin contains Barun-Torey and Zun-Torey, neighbouring soda lakes linked by the Utochi channel. With no outlet to the sea, their waters expand or retreat dramatically through decades-long wet and dry cycles.
simp_chinese: 查干位于蒙古边境附近的托列伊湖地区。更广阔的盆地中有巴伦托列伊与宗托列伊两座相邻苏打湖，以乌托奇水道连接。由于没有通海出口，湖水随持续数十年的干湿周期显著涨落。

english: Tsagaan Agui is a Gobi cave in Mongolia’s southern Altai foothills. Crystal-lined chambers preserve layered Paleolithic deposits, while Buddhist pilgrims have also visited the cave intermittently.
simp_chinese: 查干阿贵是蒙古阿尔泰南麓的一处戈壁洞穴。晶体覆盖的洞室保存着多层旧石器时代遗存，佛教朝圣者也曾不时来访。

english: Tsagaan Usun belongs to the Khovd country of western Mongolia. The surrounding wider region combines mountains and grassy steppe, within a plateau whose history was shaped by successive nomadic empires.
simp_chinese: 查干乌苏属于蒙古西部科布多地区。周边大区域兼有山地与草原，所在高原的历史深受历代游牧帝国塑造。

english: Tsageri stands on the Tskhenistsqali in western Georgia. It was a medieval bishop's seat, known for its cathedral. Nineteenth-century restoration altered the old basilica and destroyed wall paintings that had included portraits of Queen Tamar and George IV.
simp_chinese: 察盖里位于格鲁吉亚西部茨亨尼斯茨卡利河畔，中世纪是以主教座堂闻名的主教驻地。十九世纪修复改变了古老巴西利卡，并毁去曾绘有塔玛尔女王与吉奥尔基四世像的壁画。

english: Tsagvli belongs to Kartli, the Georgian historical country crossed by the Mtkvari. The wider region played a central role in medieval Georgian political life and became a separate kingdom after Georgia’s fifteenth-century division.
simp_chinese: 察格夫利属于姆特克瓦里河穿过的格鲁吉亚历史地区卡尔特利。更广阔的地区在中世纪格鲁吉亚政治中居于核心地位，并在十五世纪格鲁吉亚分裂后成为独立王国。

english: Tsaidam is a hyperarid basin on the northern Tibetan Plateau. Salt lakes and dry playas cover a large part of its floor, recalling the name’s meaning of salt marsh.
simp_chinese: 柴达木是青藏高原北部的一片极干旱盆地。盐湖与干盐滩覆盖大片盆底，使人联想到地名盐泽的含义。

english: The Tsaidam Dunes lie in the hyperarid Qaidam Basin of the northeastern Tibetan Plateau. Much of the wider basin is desert, while saline lakes and playas occupy large stretches of its floor.
simp_chinese: 柴达木沙丘位于青藏高原东北部极端干旱的柴达木盆地。更广盆地很大部分为沙漠，咸水湖和盐滩占据大片盆底。

english: Western Shoshone communities inhabit the Great Basin across parts of Nevada, California, Utah and Idaho. Their closely related tribes share a western Shoshone dialect, with lands recorded in the Ruby Valley treaty of 1863.
simp_chinese: 西肖肖尼诸社群生活在大盆地，分布于内华达、加利福尼亚、犹他和爱达荷部分地区。关系密切的各族使用西肖肖尼方言，其土地见于1863年《鲁比谷条约》。

english: Tsakhalkho belongs to the Tsawarong country, a traditional southern gateway into Tibet from Yunnan. The wider region lies along the tea-horse road and the Nu River, in dry valleys that also form part of the pilgrimage circuit around Khawa Karpo.
simp_chinese: 擦卡洛属于察瓦龙地域，这里传统上是从云南进入西藏的南部门户。广阔地区沿茶马古道和怒江展开，干旱河谷也是卡瓦格博转山朝圣路线的一部分。

english: Tsala'ihmec belongs to the Columbia Plateau landscape between the Cascades and the Rocky Mountains. Across the broader plateau, repeated lava flows built deep layers of basalt, later cut through by the Columbia River.
simp_chinese: 察拉伊梅克属于喀斯喀特山脉与落基山脉之间的哥伦比亚高原地带。就整片高原而言，反复喷出的熔岩堆积成厚重玄武岩层，哥伦比亚河后来切穿了这些岩层。

english: Tsalagi is a name of the Cherokee peoples of the southeastern woodlands. Their towns occupied river valleys across the southern Appalachians, with hunting grounds extending farther north. This combination of settled valleys and wider upland territory shaped their relationship with the interior landscape.
simp_chinese: 察拉吉是东南林地切罗基人的名称之一。城镇分布于阿巴拉契亚南部河谷，猎场则向更北方延伸。定居河谷与广阔高地领土的结合，塑造了他们同内陆景观的关系。

english: Tsalenjikha stands on the Chanistsqali in western Georgia. It was a residence of Mingrelia’s Dadiani rulers and a bishopric with a medieval cathedral.
simp_chinese: 察伦吉哈位于格鲁吉亚西部查尼斯茨卡利河畔。它曾是明格列利亚达季阿尼统治者的驻地，也是拥有中世纪主教座堂的教区中心。

english: Tsana belongs to the historical Begemder country of northwestern Ethiopia. The name once applied particularly to land east of Lake Tana, and its uncertain etymology has been linked both with dry country and with sheep rearing.
simp_chinese: 察纳位于埃塞俄比亚西北部历史上的贝格姆德尔地区。该名曾特别用于塔纳湖以东土地，其不确定的词源被分别联系于干旱地域与养羊。

english: Tsangdram belongs to Tibet, a high plateau region and the homeland of the Tibetans. From the seventh century, the Yarlung dynasty expanded into surrounding lands, building an empire that eventually stretched from the Pamirs toward Yunnan and Bengal.
simp_chinese: 藏章属于西藏，这片高原是藏族的故土。自七世纪起，雅砻王朝向周围扩张，其帝国后来从帕米尔一带延伸至云南与孟加拉方向。

english: Tsaparang was a capital of Guge above the upper Sutlej. Its fortress crowns a steep rock threaded with caves and tunnels, while ordinary houses stood below the elevated religious and royal buildings.
simp_chinese: 札布让曾是萨特累季河上游之上的古格都城。城堡高踞布满洞穴与隧道的陡岩，普通住宅位于下方，高处则是宗教与王室建筑。

english: Tsarahafatra belongs to northern Madagascar, the great island off southeastern Africa. Madagascar’s long separation from Africa and India allowed many of its plants and animals to evolve in isolation.
simp_chinese: 察拉哈法特拉属于非洲东南岸外大岛马达加斯加的北部。马达加斯加与非洲及印度长期分离，使许多动植物得以在隔绝环境中演化。

english: Tsaratanana stands on the Kamoro River in Madagascar. Rice farming and livestock raising provide most livelihoods, with bananas and cassava also cultivated. Its rural community links a river settlement with the agricultural country of the Betsiboka region.
simp_chinese: 察拉塔纳纳位于马达加斯加卡莫罗河畔。稻作与畜牧提供主要生计，也种植香蕉和木薯。乡村社群将河畔聚落同贝齐布卡地区农业土地连接。

english: Tsaribrod lies in the upper Nišava valley near the Serbian–Bulgarian frontier. Now called Dimitrovgrad, the town retains a substantial Bulgarian community.
simp_chinese: 察里布罗德位于塞尔维亚与保加利亚边界附近的尼沙瓦河上游谷地。今称季米特洛夫格勒，城镇仍有较大的保加利亚人社群。

english: The Tsaris Mountains rise west of Maltahöhe in Namibia’s desert country. The Tsaris Pass cuts through the range toward Sesriem and Sossusvlei, providing a steep crossing between the inland settlement country and the Namib landscape.
simp_chinese: 察里斯山脉耸立于纳米比亚马尔塔赫厄以西的荒漠地区。察里斯山口穿过山脉通向塞斯瑞姆与索苏斯弗雷，形成内陆聚落地区与纳米布景观之间的陡峭通道。

english: Tsaryovo Gorodishche belongs to western Siberia between the Urals and the Yenisei. Most of that broader region lies on the West Siberian Plain. The Ob and Irtysh are its principal rivers, carrying the region’s drainage toward the Kara Sea.
simp_chinese: 察廖沃古城属于乌拉尔与叶尼塞河之间的西西伯利亚。广义地区大部位于西西伯利亚平原。鄂毕河与额尔齐斯河是主要河流，将地区水流输送向喀拉海。

english: Tsau lies in the wider arid country of Great Namaqualand in southern Namibia. The Orange River divides this broad region from Little Namaqualand to the south. Nama communities, a Khoikhoi people, have traditionally inhabited a landscape of sparse settlement, semidesert and striking seasonal contrasts.
simp_chinese: 察乌位于纳米比亚南部较广的大纳马夸兰干旱地域。奥兰治河将其与南方小纳马夸兰分开。属于科伊科伊族群的纳马社群传统上居住于此，地域兼具稀疏聚落、半荒漠与鲜明季节变化。

english: Tsaukambo-speaking communities live in southern New Guinea’s Boven Digoel country. Their language belongs to the Greater Awyu group and is spoken at Biwage.
simp_chinese: 曹坎博语社群生活在新几内亚南部博文迪古尔地区。其语言属于大阿尤语群，在比瓦格使用。

english: Tsay’iona belongs to Kaska Dena country in the Canadian northwest. The wider Kaska people speak an Athabaskan language and occupy northern British Columbia and southeastern Yukon, with local bands associated with the Frances, Dease and Liard river systems.
simp_chinese: 采约纳属于加拿大西北部卡斯卡德纳地区。更广阔的卡斯卡人使用阿萨巴斯卡语族语言，居于不列颠哥伦比亚北部和育空东南部，各地方群体与弗朗西斯、迪斯及利亚德河水系相联系。

english: Tsay'keh lies in the country of the upper Peace River and the Rocky Mountain Trench. Here the Parsnip and Finlay once met at Finlay Forks to form the Peace. In 1968 the Bennett Dam created Williston Lake, flooding Tsay Keh Dene homes and territory.
simp_chinese: 蔡凯地处和平河上游与落基山沟谷地区。帕斯尼普河与芬利河昔日在芬利福克斯汇合，形成和平河。1968年，贝内特大坝蓄成威利斯顿湖，淹没了蔡凯德内人的家园与土地。

english: Tse Binesti-e belongs to the broader river country of the Akimel Oodham. Their name means river people, and their communities are associated with the Gila and Salt rivers of Arizona.
simp_chinese: 策比内斯蒂耶属于阿基梅尔奥奥德姆人的广义河流地区。他们的名称意为河流之民，其社群与亚利桑那的希拉河和盐河相联系。

english: Tsé Bit’a’í, the winged rock, rises sharply above the high desert of northwestern New Mexico. Known in English as Shiprock, it is a major landmark of the Four Corners region. Navajo tradition connects its name with a great bird that carried the people from the north.
simp_chinese: 采比塔伊意为有翼之岩，耸立在新墨西哥西北部的高地荒漠之上。英语称其为船岩，是四角地区的重要地标。纳瓦霍传统将这一名称与载着族人自北方迁来的巨鸟相联系。

english: The Tse’khene inhabit the Finlay and Parsnip river country of British Columbia’s northern interior. Their Athabaskan name is associated with people on the rocks, and their neighbours include the Babine, Dakelh and Dunneza.
simp_chinese: 策克内人生活在不列颠哥伦比亚北部内陆芬利河与帕斯尼普河地区。阿萨巴斯卡语族名与“岩石上的人”有关，邻族包括巴宾、达凯尔及邓内扎人。

english: Tsedzong belongs to the Namru country within the broader Changtang plateau. The wider landscape stretches across northern Tibet, where highland lakes and grazing lands support nomadic Tibetan pastoralists known as Changpa, northerners.
simp_chinese: 泽当属于广义羌塘高原中的朗如地域。整个景观横跨西藏北部，高原湖泊与草场支撑着称为羌巴、即“北方人”的藏族游牧社群。

english: Tséichí belongs to the Guachichil world of northern central Mexico. Across the wider region, mobile warriors used their knowledge of the land to raid Spanish roads and mining settlements, helping sustain the long Chichimeca resistance.
simp_chinese: 采奇属于墨西哥中北部瓜奇奇尔世界。更广阔区域中的流动作战者利用对土地的熟悉，袭击西班牙道路与矿业聚落，支撑长期奇奇梅克抵抗。

english: Tsekani belongs to the homeland of the Sekani, or Tsekhene, in the northern interior of British Columbia. Their territory embraces the Finlay and Parsnip drainages of the Rocky Mountain Trench; their own name means people on the rocks.
simp_chinese: 策卡尼属于不列颠哥伦比亚内陆北部塞卡尼人的家园。其领地涵盖落基山沟的芬利河与帕斯尼普河流域，族名意为“岩石上的人”。

english: Tsél tátli dshä lies in the broader dry-country setting of the Coahuiltecan peoples. Across southern Texas and northeastern Mexico, these diverse communities occupied brushy plains, with their ranges crossing the Rio Grande rather than following later national borders.
simp_chinese: 采尔塔特利查位于科阿韦尔特坎诸族更广阔的干旱地区。得克萨斯南部和墨西哥东北部的这些多样社群居于灌丛平原，活动范围跨越格兰德河，并不受后来国界限制。

english: Tselgaii belongs to the Hopi country around Oraibi on Arizona's Third Mesa. Founded around 1100, Oraibi became an enduring population centre; archaeologists suggest that late-thirteenth-century droughts encouraged people from smaller villages to gather into such larger settlements.
simp_chinese: 策尔盖属于亚利桑那第三台地奥赖比周边的霍皮人地区。奥赖比约于1100年建立，成为长期延续的人口中心；考古学家认为，十三世纪末的干旱促使一些小村落居民汇聚到这类较大聚落中。

english: Tsemes Bay is an ice-free inlet on the northeastern Black Sea coast. Named for the river entering it, the bay is bounded by the Sudzhuk spit and Cape Doob.
simp_chinese: 采梅斯湾是黑海东北岸的一处不冻海湾。它得名于汇入湾中的河流，边界由苏朱克沙嘴与多布角标示。

english: Tsentral belongs to the broader Angara basin of central Siberia. The Angara carries the waters of Lake Baikal toward the Yenisei and was historically known in its lower reaches as Upper Tunguska.
simp_chinese: 岑特拉尔属于西伯利亚中部广义的安加拉河流域。安加拉河将贝加尔湖水输向叶尼塞河，其下游历史上曾被称为上通古斯卡河。

english: Tsepina was a fortified town in Bulgaria’s western Rhodopes. A citadel crowned its steep height, while excavations revealed churches and deep cisterns within the defended area.
simp_chinese: 采皮纳曾是保加利亚西罗多彼山的一座设防城镇。陡峭高地上耸立着内堡，发掘则在防御区域内发现教堂与深蓄水池。

english: The Tses’kiya Trail belongs to the Tsetsaut homeland around the head of Portland Canal. The Tsetsaut were an Athabaskan-speaking people whose country straddled the present Alaska–British Columbia border, and their neighbours called them people “of the Interior.”
simp_chinese: 策斯基亚小径属于波特兰水道顶端周围的切苏特人故土。切苏特人使用阿萨巴斯卡语，土地跨越今阿拉斯加与不列颠哥伦比亚边界，邻族称他们为“内陆之民”。

english: Tses tsembai lies in the wider Texas region. In pre-Columbian North America, this large territory connected the Southwestern and Plains cultural spheres, while the Rio Grande and Gulf of Mexico marked its southern and coastal margins.
simp_chinese: 采斯采姆拜位于广义的得克萨斯地区。在哥伦布到来之前的北美洲，这片广大土地连接西南与大平原文化圈，格兰德河与墨西哥湾则构成其南方和沿海边缘。

english: Tsésh ke shéndé belongs to the dry country of Aridoamerica. In the wider cultural region, scarce rainfall feeds seasonal creeks and waterholes, and the drought-resistant tepary bean became a significant staple crop.
simp_chinese: 采什克申德属于干旱美洲地区。在更广阔的文化区域内，稀少降雨补给季节性溪流与水洼，耐旱的尖叶菜豆成为重要主粮作物。

english: Ts’esi lies in Racha, the highland country of the upper Rioni Valley in western Georgia. Spurs of the Greater Caucasus separate this wider region from Imereti and neighboring valleys; Racha’s history reaches back to Colchis and Caucasian Iberia.
simp_chinese: 采西位于格鲁吉亚西部里奥尼河上游谷地的拉恰山区。大高加索山脉的支脉将这一大区与伊梅列季及邻近谷地分隔，拉恰的历史可追溯至科尔基斯与高加索伊比利亚时代。

english: Tsetserleg stands in the central Mongolian uplands at about 1,570 metres. Its name means garden in old Mongolian, and the surrounding district served as an assembly place in Qing times; its continental climate has relatively mild summers.
simp_chinese: 车车尔勒格坐落于蒙古中部高地，海拔约1570米。其名称在古蒙古语中意为园林，周边地区在清代曾为会盟之地；大陆性气候下的夏季相对凉爽。

english: Tsezhin Deezahi belongs to the Black Mesa country of northeastern Arizona. The wider mesa rises on the Colorado Plateau near Kayenta, its dark appearance coming from pinyon-juniper and mixed conifer woodland.
simp_chinese: 采津德扎希属于亚利桑那东北部黑台地地域。整个台地耸立于凯恩塔附近的科罗拉多高原，矮松、杜松与混合针叶林使其呈现深色外观。

english: Tsherlung belongs to the western Tibetan country of Ngari. The wider region was once known as Zhangzhung, whose ancient kingdom and sites are closely associated in Tibetan tradition with the origins and spread of Bon.
simp_chinese: 才龙属于藏地西部阿里地区。更广阔的区域古称象雄，其古代王国与遗址在藏地传统中与苯教起源传播紧密相连。

english: Tshwa communities speak an East Kalahari Khoe dialect cluster in Botswana and Zimbabwe. Its Tjwao variety preserves the only Khoisan language spoken in Zimbabwe.
simp_chinese: 茨瓦社群在博茨瓦纳和津巴布韦使用东卡拉哈里科埃语的一组方言。其中的特瓦奥变体保留着津巴布韦唯一使用的科伊桑语言。

english: Tŝideldel lies on the Chilanko River in the Chilcotin interior of British Columbia. It is a Tsilhqot’in community near Chilanko Forks, distinct from the similarly named Redstone locality farther east.
simp_chinese: 齐德尔德尔位于不列颠哥伦比亚奇尔科廷内陆的奇兰科河畔。它是奇兰科福克斯附近的奇尔科廷人社群，与更东方同名的雷德斯通地点有所区别。

english: The surrounding Adirondack massif forms a broad dome in northeastern New York. Its mountains enclose thousands of lakes and ponds, while Mount Marcy rises above all other peaks in the state.
simp_chinese: 周围的阿迪朗达克山地在纽约州东北部形成宽广的穹状地形。群山间分布着数千处湖泊与池塘，其中马西山是全州最高峰。

english: Tsiigehtchic stands where the Mackenzie meets the Arctic Red River. Archaeology and oral history indicate that Gwich'in people used the flats below the community for about fourteen hundred years, long before Alexander Mackenzie's arrival in 1789.
simp_chinese: 齐格奇克位于马更些河与北极红河汇合处。考古与口述历史表明，格威迅人使用社区下方滩地约一千四百年，远早于亚历山大·马更些1789年抵达。

english: Tsikahiotsisto belongs to the wider Haudenosaunee world. Across the confederacy, oral history preserves the Great Law of Peace, while the later fur trade and acquisition of muskets transformed its regional power.
simp_chinese: 齐卡希奥齐斯托属于广阔的豪德诺索尼世界。在整个联盟，口述历史保存《大和平法》传统，后来的毛皮贸易与火枪获取则改变了其区域力量。

english: Tsikip belongs to the Louisiana country near the lower Mississippi world. In the wider region, hunter-gatherer communities built complex earthworks as early as the fourth millennium BC, leaving some of North America’s oldest mound complexes.
simp_chinese: 齐基普属于密西西比河下游世界附近的路易斯安那地区。在更广阔的区域，狩猎采集社群早在公元前四千纪便修筑复杂土方工程，留下北美最古老的一批土丘遗址。

english: Tsila belongs to the ancestral San country of the central Kalahari. Hunting and gathering remained central to the inhabitants’ livelihood and identity. Modern disputes over relocation from the Central Kalahari Game Reserve culminated in a 2006 court ruling that residents had been wrongfully removed.
simp_chinese: 齐拉属于卡拉哈里中部桑人的祖居地域。狩猎采集始终是居民生计与认同的核心。围绕中央卡拉哈里保护区居民迁移的现代争议，最终促成二〇〇六年的法院判决，认定居民遭到不当迁离。

english: Tsilalanarivo belongs to the Bezanozano country between Madagascar’s eastern lowlands and central highlands. The Bezanozano name refers to their traditional small plaits, and their ancestral tombs have long served as places of pilgrimage and ritual.
simp_chinese: 齐拉拉纳里武属于马达加斯加东部低地与中央高地之间的贝扎诺扎诺地区。贝扎诺扎诺之名源于其传统细辫发式，祖先墓地长期是朝拜与仪式的场所。

english: Tsimanandrafozana belongs to Menabe in western Madagascar. The regional name means “big red”, referring to the laterite that colours much of the landscape. Menabe became the southern centre of Sakalava power, with traditions dating its kingdom’s foundation to the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 奇马南德拉富扎纳属于马达加斯加西部梅纳贝。地区名称意为“大红”，指使大量景观染色的红土。梅纳贝后来成为萨卡拉瓦势力的南部中心，传统将其王国起源追溯至16世纪。

english: The Tsimané inhabit lowland Bolivia's Beni country. Subsistence cultivation supplies much of their food, supplemented substantially by hunting and fishing around forest settlements.
simp_chinese: 齐马内人居住在玻利维亚低地的贝尼地区。自给种植提供大部分食物，森林聚落周边的狩猎与捕鱼则构成重要补充。

english: Tsindi belongs to the upper Mazowe country of the Zambezi region. As background to this wider drainage system, the Zambezi is Africa’s largest river flowing into the Indian Ocean and gathers waters from a basin spanning about 1.39 million square kilometres.
simp_chinese: 钦迪属于赞比西地区的上马佐韦地带。作为更广阔水系的背景，赞比西河是非洲注入印度洋的最大河流，汇集约139万平方公里流域的水源。

english: Tsipanda belongs to the wider eastern Siberian country near its eastern mountain lands. In the broader region, southern ranges contrast with the Central Siberian Plateau and the tundra of the north.
simp_chinese: 齐潘达属于东西伯利亚更广阔的地域，靠近其东部山地。就更大区域而言，南部山脉与中西伯利亚高原和北部苔原构成不同景观。

english: Tsiripa lies in the wider Paraguay region of central South America. Guarani communities had occupied eastern Paraguay for at least a millennium before Spanish arrival, while the Parana–Paraguay waterways connect this landlocked interior to the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 奇里帕位于南美洲中部广义的巴拉圭地区。西班牙人到来以前，瓜拉尼社群已在巴拉圭东部生活至少一千年；巴拉那—巴拉圭水道则把内陆与大西洋联系起来。

english: Tsitsiadi belongs to the wider Great Basin of western North America. This arid country is characterized by enclosed watersheds that drain inland rather than reaching the ocean, amid alternating mountain ranges and basins.
simp_chinese: 齐齐亚迪属于北美西部更广阔的大盆地。这片干旱地域以向内陆排水、不通大海的封闭流域为特点，山脉与盆地相间分布。

english: The Tsitsikamma Mountains run along South Africa's southern coast and continue westwards into the Outeniqua range. Resistant sandstone forms their steep ridges. Abundant rain sustains fynbos and temperate forests, fitting a Khoekhoe name meaning Place of Much Water.
simp_chinese: 齐齐卡马山脉沿南非南岸延伸，向西连接奥特尼夸山系。坚硬砂岩形成陡峭山脊，充足雨量滋养芬博斯与温带森林，与科伊科伊语多水之地的山名相符。

english: Tsiveri belongs to the Tandroy country of southern Madagascar. The Tandroy formed a seventeenth-century confederation under the Zafimanara dynasty, which broke apart after severe flooding around 1790; arid terrain and a difficult climate helped keep the region beyond Imerina's nineteenth-century conquests.
simp_chinese: 奇韦里属于马达加斯加南部的坦德鲁伊地区。十七世纪，坦德鲁伊人在扎菲马纳拉王朝统治下形成联盟，约1790年大洪水后瓦解；干旱而艰难的地形气候，使当地在十九世纪仍未被伊梅里纳征服。

english: Tsivilsk began as a Russian military outpost among the Chuvash in 1589. The town lies near Cheboksary, at a meeting of routes linking the middle Volga country.
simp_chinese: 齐维利斯克于1589年作为楚瓦什人地区的俄罗斯军事前哨建立。城镇靠近切博克萨雷，处于连接伏尔加河中游地区的道路交汇点。

english: Tsi’ya is the Keres name of Zia Pueblo in New Mexico. The historic pueblo remains within the modern settlement, whose population was 760 in 2020.
simp_chinese: 齐亚是新墨西哥齐亚普韦布洛的凯雷斯语名称。历史聚落仍包含在现代社区内，2020年居民为760人。

english: The Tsnungwe inhabit the Trinity River country of northern California. Their communities traditionally used Hupa and Chimariko, with their name associated with Ironside Mountain.
simp_chinese: 茨农韦人居住在加利福尼亚北部特里尼蒂河地区。社群传统上使用胡帕语与奇马里科语，族名则与艾恩赛德山相连。

english: Tso Gon belongs to the Taozhou region of southern Gansu, represented today by Lintan County. The wider region’s history includes Tibetan and Muslim communities whose alliances and conflicts shaped the nineteenth-century frontier.
simp_chinese: 措贡属于甘肃南部的洮州地区，今以临潭县为代表。广大地区历史包括藏族与穆斯林社群，其结盟与冲突影响了十九世纪边疆。

english: Tsogt lies in the Gobi Altai region of Mongolia. Across the wider country, mountain landscapes in the north and west meet grassy steppes and the southern Gobi Desert; nomadic powers long preceded the empire founded by Genghis Khan.
simp_chinese: 朝格特位于蒙古戈壁阿尔泰地区。从更广阔的国土看，北部、西部山地与草原和南部戈壁沙漠相接；成吉思汗建立帝国以前，游牧政权已在这片土地上长期兴替。

english: Western Shoshone communities inhabit the Great Basin across Nevada and neighbouring states. The 1863 Treaty of Ruby Valley identified lands associated with these closely related tribes.
simp_chinese: 西肖肖尼社群生活在内华达及邻州的大盆地地区。1863年红宝石谷条约记载了这些关系密切部族的相关土地。

english: Tsoka-ne-nde belongs to the broader Akimel O’odham setting of the North American Southwest. The people’s name means “river people”, distinguishing them from related O’odham communities associated with desert and sand-dune environments. Their modern communities include those on the Gila and Salt rivers.
simp_chinese: 措卡内恩德属于北美西南部广义阿基梅尔奥奥德姆地区。该族名称意为“河流之民”，与相关的沙漠及沙丘环境奥奥德姆社群有所区分。其现代社群包括吉拉河与盐河沿岸居民。

english: Tsokh belongs to the wider Buryatian setting near the southern Siberian borderlands. The region extends east of Lake Baikal and north of Mongolia, within a landscape linking Siberian river valleys and the Mongolian interior.
simp_chinese: 措赫属于西伯利亚南部边地的布里亚特地域背景。广大地区位于贝加尔湖以东、蒙古以北，联系着西伯利亚河谷与蒙古内陆。

english: Tsonentsiio belongs to the broader Haudenosaunee country. The Confederacy’s oral traditions place the Great Law of Peace at the center of its political union, associated with the Great Peacemaker and Hiawatha.
simp_chinese: 措嫩齐奥属于更广阔的豪德诺索尼地区。联盟的口述传统将大和平法置于政治联合的核心，并将其与大和平缔造者和海华沙相联系。

english: Tsonga Lake belongs to the northern Tibetan world of Changtang. The wider highlands once formed part of Zhangzhung’s cultural sphere before merging into the Tibetan world, and remain associated with nomadic pastoralism.
simp_chinese: 宗嘎错属于藏北羌塘世界。广义高地曾属象雄文化圈，后来融入藏文化世界，并持续与游牧畜牧业相联系。

english: Tsontaroy Kala belongs to the historical Chechen country of Simsim. Persian chronicles known as the Zafarnama preserve this regional name, while Fasih Khwafi called it Ulus Simsim.
simp_chinese: 宗塔罗伊卡拉属于车臣历史上的西姆西姆地区。名为《胜利之书》的波斯编年史保存了这一地域名称，法西赫·赫瓦菲则称其为西姆西姆兀鲁思。

english: Tsora lies in Ü, the eastern part of Central Tibet. The wider region includes the Lhasa River valley and the Yarlung and Chonggye valleys south of the Tsangpo. Together with Tsang, Ü forms a historic centre of Tibetan civilization.
simp_chinese: 措拉位于卫地，即藏中地区的东部。广义的卫地包括拉萨河谷，以及雅鲁藏布江以南的雅隆与琼结河谷。卫与藏共同构成西藏文明的历史中心。

english: Tsorub belongs to the wider Spiti highland region. Spiti is a cold Himalayan desert centred on the Spiti River and its tributary valleys, where Tibetan Buddhist traditions remain prominent.
simp_chinese: 措如属于更广阔的斯皮蒂高地。斯皮蒂是以斯皮蒂河及其支流河谷为中心的喜马拉雅寒冷荒漠，藏传佛教传统在这里十分重要。

english: Tsou belongs to southern Taiwan’s island landscape. Across Taiwan as a whole, mountains dominate the eastern two-thirds while the western third is largely plains; archaeological remains attest to human presence many millennia before the historical era.
simp_chinese: 邹社属于台湾南部的岛屿地域。就整个台湾而言，东部三分之二以山地为主，西部三分之一多为平原；考古遗存显示早在历史时代之前许多千年已有人类活动。

english: The Yuchi lived in the eastern Tennessee River valley during the sixteenth century. Many later moved south toward Muscogee country before disease, warfare and forced removal carried surviving communities to Indian Territory.
simp_chinese: 措亚哈即尤奇人，十六世纪居住在田纳西河谷东部。许多人后来南迁马斯科吉地区，疾病、战争与强制迁移又将幸存社群带到印第安领地。

english: Tsudaka belongs to Bizen in the San’yō circuit. The wider road crossed western Honshu’s southern side toward the Seto Inland Sea coast; its old administrative framework arose during the Asuka period, while the route remained important after that framework weakened.
simp_chinese: 津高属于山阳道备前国。更广阔的道路沿本州西部南侧通向濑户内海海岸，其古代行政体系形成于飞鸟时期，道路在制度衰退后仍保持重要地位。

english: Tsuga lies in Shimotsuke, one of the provinces of ancient Tōsandō. The circuit was both a geographical division and a road system connecting provincial capitals. It linked the central mountain country of Honshu with the northern lands of Mutsu and Dewa.
simp_chinese: 都贺位于古代东山道所辖的下野国。东山道既是地理划分，也是连接各国国府的道路体系。它把本州中部山地与北方陆奥、出羽相连。

english: Tsugaru Strait separates Honshu from Hokkaido and connects the Sea of Japan with the Pacific. Older Western charts called it the Strait of Sangar, while the modern Seikan Tunnel crosses beneath its narrowest section.
simp_chinese: 津轻海峡分隔本州与北海道，连接日本海及太平洋。较早西方海图称其为桑加尔海峡，现代青函隧道则穿过最窄处下方。

english: Tsukama belonged to Shinano in Japan's Tōsandō circuit. Across the wider mountain region, Tōsandō referred both to a division of the realm and to roads linking provincial capitals. Shinano formed part of this network alongside Mino, Hida, Kōzuke and other provinces.
simp_chinese: 筑摩属于日本东山道的信浓国。在更广阔的山地地区，东山道既是国土区划名称，也指连接诸国国府的道路。信浓与美浓、飞驒、上野等国共同构成这一网络。

english: The Tsukuba country lies on the Kantō Plain beneath Mount Tsukuba. The mountain gives the settlement its name and interrupts otherwise low terrain. Several rivers cross the district towards the Tone system and nearby lakes.
simp_chinese: 筑波地区位于筑波山下的关东平原，山体赋予聚落名称，也打破周边低平地势。多条河流穿过地区，通向利根水系及附近湖泊。

english: Tsuno belongs to Suō, an old province of the San’yōdō circuit. Before the ritsuryō system, Tsunu was among the semi-independent local territories of the region. The later provincial capital and Tamanooya Shrine stood at present-day Hōfu, while Suō bordered Aki, Iwami and Nagato.
simp_chinese: 都浓属于山阳道的古国周防。律令制度建立以前，都怒便是当地半独立地域之一。后来的国府与玉祖神社位于今日防府，周防则与安艺、石见及长门接壤。

english: Tsunthang belongs to Sikkim in the eastern Himalaya, a region ranging from subtropical valleys to alpine heights. The wider kingdom was founded by the Namgyal dynasty in the seventeenth century and ruled by Buddhist priest-kings called Chogyals.
simp_chinese: 春塘处于喜马拉雅山东段的锡金地区，这里从亚热带河谷延伸至高山地带。广义的锡金王国由南嘉王朝在十七世纪建立，由称为却嘉的佛教法王统治。

english: Tsurphu is the traditional seat of the Karmapa in Tibet’s Karma Kagyu lineage. Its monastery faces south in a high valley surrounded by mountains west of Lhasa.
simp_chinese: 楚布寺是西藏噶玛噶举传承中噶玛巴的传统驻锡地。寺院在拉萨以西群山环绕的高谷中面向南方。

english: Tsuru belongs to Kai, the old Japanese province corresponding broadly to modern Yamanashi. In the wider province, the Takeda held the shugo office and rose to their greatest power under Takeda Shingen, while the Oyamada governed the eastern Gunnai country before their destruction in 1582.
simp_chinese: 都留属于甲斐，古国范围大致对应今天的山梨县。放眼全甲斐，武田氏担任守护，在武田信玄时期达到鼎盛；小山田氏则统治东部郡内地方，直至1582年灭亡。

english: Tsuruga occupies a sheltered bay north of Lake Biwa. Mountains enclose three sides of the harbour, while its peninsula protects the anchorage from winds and waves of the Sea of Japan.
simp_chinese: 敦贺位于琵琶湖以北的避风海湾。三面山地环绕港湾，半岛则保护锚地免受日本海风浪侵袭。

english: Tsybuliv is a settlement in the Uman country of central Ukraine. It belongs to the Monastyryshche community and became administratively rural when Ukraine abolished urban-type settlement status in 2024.
simp_chinese: 齐布利夫是乌克兰中部乌曼地区的一处聚落。它属于莫纳斯特里谢社群，2024年乌克兰取消城镇型聚落类别后，行政上改列乡村聚落。

english: Pasiwvi belongs to the wider Aridoamerican country of northern Mexico and southwestern North America. Sparse rainfall feeds seasonal streams and waterholes, shaping distinctive regional cultures and ways of subsistence.
simp_chinese: 帕西维属于墨西哥北部与北美西南更广阔的干旱美洲地区。稀少降水补给季节性溪流与水穴，塑造了独特的地区文化和生计方式。

english: Tu e Dine de belongs to the lands associated with the Lipan Apache. The wider Lipan people were the easternmost Apache band, moving across the Southwest and Southern Plains into Texas and northern Mexico.
simp_chinese: 图埃迪内德属于与利潘阿帕奇人相关的土地。整个利潘族群是阿帕奇人最东部的分支，活动范围横跨西南地区与南部平原，延伸至得克萨斯和墨西哥北部。

english: Tu Nedhe is a region of Canada’s Northwest Territories. Its modern district brought together the communities of Fort Resolution and Lutselk’e.
simp_chinese: 图内德是加拿大西北地区的一片地方。现代同名行政选区曾将雷索卢申堡与卢特塞尔克两处社群联系在一起。

english: Tu Sis Nde belongs to the southern Plains world of the Lipan Apache. Their language and ancestry link them to the Southern Athabaskan peoples, while the name Lipan reflects a self-designation interpreted as “Light Gray People”.
simp_chinese: 图西斯恩德属于利潘阿帕奇人的南部平原世界。其语言和族源与南阿萨巴斯卡诸族相连，利潘之名则反映了被解释为“浅灰色之人”的自称。

english: Tuam became a major political and religious centre of medieval Connacht. The high kings Tairrdelbach and Ruaidrí maintained their base here. A market-centred street plan also reflects the importance of commerce to the town.
simp_chinese: 蒂厄姆发展为中世纪康诺特的重要政治宗教中心，至高王托尔洛赫与罗里曾以此为驻地。围绕市场的街道布局也体现了商业对城镇的重要性。

english: The Tuamotu waters surround a vast chain of coral islands and atolls in French Polynesia. Polynesian settlement gave the islands a shared cultural heritage and the Tuamotuan language.
simp_chinese: 土阿莫土水域环绕着法属波利尼西亚一条广阔的珊瑚岛与环礁链。波利尼西亚人的定居为这些岛屿带来了共同的文化传统和土阿莫土语。

english: Tureia, also called Papakena, is an atoll in the Tuamotu Archipelago. A long island occupies its eastern reef, and the enclosed lagoon has no navigable entrance from the surrounding sea.
simp_chinese: 图雷亚又称帕帕凯纳，是土阿莫土群岛的一座环礁。一条长岛占据其东侧礁缘，封闭的潟湖没有可供船只从外海进入的通道。

english: Tuapse lies on the northeastern Black Sea coast in the homeland of the Shapsugs. Its Adyghe name means two waters, while a Russian fort established in 1838 began the modern settlement.
simp_chinese: 图阿普谢位于黑海东北岸沙普苏格人的故土。阿迪格语名称意为“两道水”，1838年建立的俄罗斯堡垒则成为现代聚落的开端。

english: Tuasi belongs to the Upper Creek country associated with Abihka. Communities along the upper Coosa and Alabama rivers formed part of this world. Abihka was one of the Creek confederacy’s four mother towns, and later received many Natchez refugees displaced by the French.
simp_chinese: 图阿西属于与阿比卡相关的上克里克地域。库萨河上游与阿拉巴马河沿岸社群构成了这一世界的一部分。阿比卡是克里克联盟四大母镇之一，后来接纳了许多被法国人驱散的纳奇兹难民。

english: Tuba lies in the wider Fouta Djallon highlands of Guinea. This region was historically home to the Jallonke and later became a major center of Fulani Islamic scholarship, including literature written in an adapted Arabic script.
simp_chinese: 图巴所在的区域属于几内亚的富塔贾隆高地。这里历史上是贾隆克人的家园，后来成为富拉尼伊斯兰学术的重要中心，并发展了使用改编阿拉伯字母的文学。

english: Tuban occupies Java’s northern coast west of Surabaya. The old town is surrounded by a varied landscape of beaches, caves and teak forests.
simp_chinese: 图班位于泗水以西的爪哇北海岸。古老城镇周边分布海滩、洞穴与柚木森林等多样景观。

english: Tubarao lies in the river basin of the same name in southern Santa Catarina. The later town grew from a stopping place founded in 1773 on the route between Laguna and the uplands.
simp_chinese: 图巴朗位于圣卡塔琳娜南部的同名河流域。后来的城镇起源于一七七三年建立的一处歇脚地，位于拉古纳通往高地的道路沿线。

english: Tubatulabam is associated with the Tübatulabal people of California’s Kern River valley. Their homeland embraced both the Kern and South Fork Kern drainages. It ranged from high mountains dotted with lakes and meadows to lower valleys of grassland and chaparral.
simp_chinese: 图巴图拉巴姆与加利福尼亚克恩河谷的图巴图拉巴尔人相联系。他们的家园包括克恩河与南支克恩河流域，从湖泊草甸点缀的高山，延伸至草地与灌丛覆盖的低谷。

english: Tubiba belongs to the wider Jaguaribe country in Ceará, northeastern Brazil. The regional namesake municipality lies inland from Fortaleza and consists overwhelmingly of rural territory, with only a small portion occupied by its urban center.
simp_chinese: 图比巴属于巴西东北部塞阿拉州的雅瓜里贝地区。地区同名市镇位于福塔莱萨内陆，广大辖境绝大部分为乡村，城市中心仅占很小一部分。

english: Tubicha Mini belongs to the Pampas of southern South America. The broader region is a vast low grassland plain, whose ecology was greatly altered after European arrivals introduced livestock such as cattle and sheep.
simp_chinese: 图比查米尼属于南美南部的潘帕地区。更广阔的地区是辽阔低平的草原，欧洲人到来后引入牛羊等牲畜，大幅改变了其生态。

english: Tubigarao belongs to Luzon, the largest island of the Philippines. The wider northern island group includes the Babuyan and Batanes islands to the north, as well as islands off the eastern coast.
simp_chinese: 图比加劳属于菲律宾最大的岛屿吕宋。广义的北部岛群还包括北方的巴布延群岛、巴丹群岛以及东岸外的岛屿。

english: Tübingen became a university town with the foundation of Eberhard's university in 1477. This Swabian centre later drew scholars and students whose institutions became a defining part of its urban life.
simp_chinese: 蒂宾根随1477年埃伯哈德大学的建立而成为大学城。这座施瓦本中心后来吸引学者与学生，教育机构成为城市生活的重要部分。

english: Tubuai is a main island of the Austral group south of Tahiti. A coral reef encloses its lagoon, with a northern opening allowing vessels to enter sheltered water.
simp_chinese: 土布艾是塔希提以南南方群岛的主要岛屿之一。珊瑚礁围绕潟湖，北侧开口让船舶能够进入受庇护水域。

english: Tubuai lies about 640 kilometres south of Tahiti in the Austral Islands. A coral reef encloses its lagoon, and its southerly position gives it cooler weather than Tahiti.
simp_chinese: 图布艾位于南方群岛，距塔希提以南约640公里。珊瑚礁环抱着岛旁潟湖，较偏南的位置使其气候比塔希提凉爽。

english: Tubuai lies south of Tahiti in the Austral Islands and is surrounded by a coral reef and lagoon. A passage in the northern reef admits ships, while volcanic domes rise above the island's shores.
simp_chinese: 图布艾位于塔希提以南的南方群岛，周围环绕珊瑚礁和潟湖。北侧礁盘水道可供船只出入，火山穹丘则耸立于海岸之上。

english: Tubula Point belongs to southeastern New Guinea’s coastal waters. In the wider Melanesian region, long sea passages connect island communities across the southwestern Pacific from New Guinea towards Fiji.
simp_chinese: 图布拉角属于新几内亚东南部沿海水域。在更广阔的美拉尼西亚地区，漫长海程连接着从新几内亚向斐济延伸的西南太平洋岛屿社群。

english: Tucanca belongs to the Paraguaná Peninsula country of Venezuela. The wider peninsula was once an island and is now linked to the mainland by the sandy Médanos tombolo.
simp_chinese: 图坎卡属于委内瑞拉的帕拉瓜纳半岛地区。更广半岛曾是岛屿，如今由梅达诺斯沙质连岛坝连接大陆。

english: The Tucanca Coast lies along the southern Caribbean margin of Venezuela. These waters belong to a wider maritime region linking the mainland shores of the Americas with the Antilles and their many islands, reefs and cays.
simp_chinese: 图坎卡海岸位于委内瑞拉的加勒比海南缘。这片水域属于更广阔的海洋地区，将美洲大陆海岸与安的列斯群岛及其众多岛屿、珊瑚礁和沙洲联系起来。

english: Tuchitua belongs to the Pelly river country of the Yukon. The wider river rises west of the Mackenzie Mountains and flows through south-central Yukon to the Yukon River, receiving the Ross and Macmillan; its Selkirk name evokes water running between mountains.
simp_chinese: 图奇图阿属于育空佩利河地区。更广阔的河流发源于麦肯齐山脉以西，经过育空中南部汇入育空河，接纳罗斯河与麦克米伦河；其塞尔柯克语名称意为山间流动之水。

english: Tucho is a Dene name for Great Slave Lake in Canada’s Northwest Territories. Reaching 614 metres, it is the deepest lake in North America.
simp_chinese: 图乔是加拿大西北地区大奴湖的德内语名称。湖水最深达614米，是北美最深的湖泊。

english: Tuchola lies beside the forests of Pomerelia. The settlement was recorded in 1287, when its church was consecrated. It passed to the Teutonic Order in 1330 and received Chełmno law in 1346, strengthening its position as a town within the wooded border country.
simp_chinese: 图霍拉位于东波美拉尼亚森林旁。1287年教堂祝圣时，聚落见于记载。1330年转归条顿骑士团，1346年获得库尔姆法，加强了在林地边境中的城镇地位。

english: Tuckabatchee was one of the four mother towns of the Muscogee confederacy. Its Upper Creek settlement stood along the Tallapoosa opposite Uphapee Creek.
simp_chinese: 塔卡巴奇是穆斯科吉联盟的四大母镇之一。这个上克里克聚落位于塔拉普萨河沿岸，与乌法皮溪相对。

english: Tuckahoe belongs to the broader Pennsylvanian country. This region connects the Appalachian interior with the Delaware valley and reaches northwest toward Lake Erie.
simp_chinese: 塔卡霍属于更广阔的宾夕法尼亚地区。这一地区连接阿巴拉契亚内陆与特拉华河谷，并向西北延伸至伊利湖。

english: Tucssa belongs to the Puna country of the Andes. In the wider highlands, separate cordilleras enclose elevated plateaus and deep intermontane depressions. The Andes form the longest continental mountain range, extending through seven countries along western South America.
simp_chinese: 图克萨属于安第斯的普纳地区。在更广阔的高地，多条山脉环绕着高原与深切山间洼地。安第斯是最长的大陆山脉，沿南美洲西部跨越七个国家。

english: Tucumcari developed from a railway construction camp established in 1901. The later town took its name from a nearby mountain, whose own name has uncertain origins. Its foundation belongs to the modern railway age, long after the older Indigenous geography of the New Mexican plains.
simp_chinese: 图克姆卡里从1901年设立的铁路施工营地发展起来。后来城镇以附近山峰命名，山名本身的来源尚不确定。建镇属于现代铁路时代，远晚于新墨西哥平原更早的原住民地理。

english: Tucupita lies on the Caño Manamo in the swampy Orinoco delta. Mangroves and diverse waterways characterize its hot, humid surroundings. A twentieth-century embankment intended to create dry land instead altered saltwater movement and damaged the delta's ecology.
simp_chinese: 图库皮塔位于沼泽密布的奥里诺科三角洲马纳莫河汊旁。炎热湿润环境中分布红树林与多样水道。二十世纪为开辟干地修建的堤坝改变盐水运动，损害了三角洲生态。

english: Tudela stands in the Ebro valley as a centre of the agricultural Ribera Navarra. The town developed from Celtiberian and Roman settlement before coming under Muslim rule. Its markets and religious institutions made it one of Navarre's principal cities.
simp_chinese: 图德拉位于埃布罗河谷，是里贝拉纳瓦拉农业区中心。城镇从凯尔特伊比利亚和罗马聚落发展，后来进入穆斯林统治。市场与宗教机构使其成为纳瓦拉主要城市之一。

english: Tudeshk belongs to the Isfahan country of Iran. The village became a city in 2001 after merging with several neighbouring settlements.
simp_chinese: 图德什克属于伊朗伊斯法罕地区。2001年，村庄与多个邻近聚落合并，升格为城市。

english: Tuf Shur Tia is the Tiwa name of Sandia Pueblo in central New Mexico. The community belongs to the eastern pueblos and traditionally speaks a Tanoan language.
simp_chinese: 图夫舒尔蒂亚是新墨西哥中部桑迪亚普韦布洛的蒂瓦语名称。社群属于东部普韦布洛，传统语言归于塔诺语系。

english: Tufarqan belongs to the city now known as Azarshahr in Iranian Azerbaijan. The settlement serves as the capital of its county in East Azerbaijan, within the district called Howmeh.
simp_chinese: 图法尔甘对应伊朗阿塞拜疆今称阿扎尔沙赫尔的城市。该聚落位于东阿塞拜疆的豪迈区，担任所属县的首府。

english: Tugacho belongs to the wider Yukon region of northwestern Canada. Its broader geographical setting lies between Alaska, the Northwest Territories and British Columbia, with the Beaufort Sea to the north.
simp_chinese: 图加乔属于加拿大西北部更广阔的育空地区。其更大地理背景处于阿拉斯加、西北地区与不列颠哥伦比亚之间，北临波弗特海。

english: Tugaloo was a Cherokee Lower Town at the junction of the Tugaloo River and Toccoa Creek. An earlier Mississippian community built a ceremonial mound here. The historic town's site was later flooded by Lake Hartwell.
simp_chinese: 图加洛是位于图加洛河与托科阿溪交汇处的切罗基下部城镇。更早的密西西比文化社群在此营建仪式土丘，历史城镇遗址后来被哈特韦尔湖淹没。

english: Tugaske belongs to the prairie landscape of southern Saskatchewan. In the wider region, Indigenous communities preceded the European fur-trading posts, among which Cumberland House was founded in 1774 as the first permanent European settlement in the province.
simp_chinese: 图加斯基属于萨斯喀彻温南部的草原地带。在更广阔的地区，原住民社会早于欧洲皮毛贸易站而存在，其中1774年建立的坎伯兰屋成为省域内首个永久欧洲聚落。

english: The Natal waters face coastal plains below the Drakensberg. These mountains separate the wetter eastern shore country from southern Africa’s high interior.
simp_chinese: 纳塔尔水域面向德拉肯斯山下的沿海平原。山地将较湿润东岸与南部非洲高内陆分隔开来。

english: Tugulym is a settlement in the Sverdlovsk country of western Siberia’s borderlands. It belongs to the surrounding Tugulymsky district.
simp_chinese: 图古雷姆是西西伯利亚边缘斯维尔德洛夫斯克地区的一处聚落。它隶属周围的图古雷姆区。

english: Tugumlepen belongs to the wider Coahuila–Texas borderland setting. The Rio Grande divides the modern territories, with Coahuila extending across a large portion of the river’s southern side.
simp_chinese: 图古姆勒彭属于科阿韦拉与得克萨斯之间的广大边地背景。格兰德河分隔现代行政地域，科阿韦拉沿河流南侧占据广阔土地。

english: Tugur follows a river formed by the Assyni and Konin in the Russian Far East. Before reaching Tugur Bay on the Sea of Okhotsk, it crosses a broad swampy plain. Salmon, grayling and lenok thrive in the river, while bears, wapiti and otters inhabit its banks.
simp_chinese: 图呼勒沿俄罗斯远东由阿瑟尼河与科宁河汇合而成的河流展开。注入鄂霍次克海图古尔湾前，河流穿过广阔沼泽平原。鲑鱼、茴鱼与细鳞鲑在水中繁衍，熊、马鹿和水獭栖息于两岸。

english: Tuin lies in Mongolia’s Valley of the Lakes between the Khangai and Govi-Altai mountains. The valley contains shallow saline lakes fed by rivers rising in the Khangai, with water levels that fluctuate greatly between seasons and years.
simp_chinese: 图音郭勒位于蒙古杭爱山与戈壁阿尔泰山之间的湖谷。谷地分布着由杭爱山河流补给的浅咸水湖，水位随季节和年份显著波动。

english: Tujun belongs to the upper Bureya river country. The river gathers water from mountain tributaries before flowing south to join the Amur, with its basin bounded by the Turan and Bureya ranges.
simp_chinese: 图浚属于布列亚河上游地区。河流从山地支流汇集水源，向南汇入黑龙江，流域两侧为图兰与布列亚等山脉。

english: The Tukangbesi Islands lie east of Buton in the Banda Sea country. Their name means blacksmith, recalling a reputation for producing traditional keris blades.
simp_chinese: 图康伯西群岛位于布顿岛以东的班达海地区。名称意为“铁匠”，让人想起当地制作传统克里斯短剑的名声。

english: Tukri Apu Apu belongs to the central Andean uplands. The wider region is a homeland of crops such as the potato and of domesticated llamas and alpacas, animals long valued for carrying goods and supplying wool and meat.
simp_chinese: 图克里阿普阿普属于中安第斯高地。更广阔的区域是马铃薯等作物以及驯化美洲驼、羊驼的故乡，这些动物长期用于驮运并提供毛料与肉食。

english: Tukspush belongs to the Molala homeland in Oregon’s Western Cascades. The wider people were known to neighbouring communities by several names, and their descendants later became part of the Grand Ronde, Siletz and Klamath tribal communities.
simp_chinese: 图克什普什属于俄勒冈西喀斯喀特山的莫拉拉家园。周边社群对这一民族使用多种名称，其后裔后来成为格兰德龙德、锡莱茨与克拉马斯等部族社群的一部分。

english: Tuktoyukiuq lies near the Mackenzie delta on the Arctic Ocean, in the homeland of the Inuvialuit. Its traditional name means resembling a caribou and is linked in local legend with coastal reefs said to resemble animals turned to stone. The settlement later known as Port Brabant reclaimed its Indigenous name in 1950.
simp_chinese: 图克托亚图克位于北冰洋岸、马更些河三角洲附近，是因纽维亚卢特人的家园。传统地名意为“形似驯鹿”，当地传说将它与岸边仿佛驯鹿化石的礁石相联系。聚落后来曾称布拉班特港，1950年恢复了原住民名称。

english: The Tukudeka were mountain Shoshone communities of Idaho's Sawtooth Range and northwestern Wyoming. Their name refers to eating mountain sheep, an important quarry. Mobile bands maintained close relations and intermarriage with other Shoshone groups.
simp_chinese: 图库德卡是爱达荷锯齿山与怀俄明西北部的山地肖肖尼社群。名称指食用重要猎物盘羊，流动各部与其他肖肖尼族群保持紧密交往和通婚。

english: Tukulans are wind-shaped sand dunes of Yakutia. They occur as isolated dunes or broad sand fields among the taiga, especially along the Lena and lower Vilyuy.
simp_chinese: 图库兰是雅库特地区由风力塑造的沙丘。它们或孤立分布，或在泰加林间形成大片沙地，尤见于勒拿河与维柳伊河下游。

english: Tukums developed among trade routes between the Daugava mouth and Prussia. Ruled by the Livonian Order from 1253, its early center lay near a wooden hillfort and the later castle on the Slocene.
simp_chinese: 图库姆斯在道加瓦河口通向普鲁士的贸易道路之间发展起来。1253年起归利沃尼亚骑士团统治，早期中心邻近木构山堡及后来斯洛采内河畔城堡。

english: Tukuran occupies a trading position on western Mindanao. Subanon, Maranao, Maguindanao and Iranun communities were among its early inhabitants. The name is linked to a word meaning to build.
simp_chinese: 图库兰占据棉兰老西部的一处贸易位置。苏巴农、马拉瑙、马京达瑙与伊拉努人是早期居民，地名则与意为建造的词语有关。

english: Tukuringra belongs to the wider Gilyuy country of the Amur region. The Gilyuy rises on the southern Stanovoy slopes and flows southeast as a tributary of the Zeya.
simp_chinese: 图库林格拉属于黑龙江地区更广阔的吉柳伊河地域。吉柳伊河发源于外兴安岭南坡，向东南流动，是结雅河的一条支流。

english: Tul’kichan belongs to the country around Chumikan and Uda Bay on the Sea of Okhotsk. Mountains surround the narrow Uda valley, while the wider coastal region long served Yakut and Evenki people as a winter port before the founding of the later Russian fishing settlement.
simp_chinese: 图尔基昌属于鄂霍次克海乌达湾和丘米坎周边地域。山地围绕狭窄的乌达河谷，而广阔的沿海地区早在后来俄国渔村建立以前，就长期作为雅库特人与鄂温克人的冬季港地。

english: Tula belongs to Tamaulipas in northeastern Mexico. The wider region faces the Gulf of Mexico to the east and connects inland towards Nuevo León and San Luis Potosí.
simp_chinese: 屠拉属于墨西哥东北部的塔毛利帕斯。更广阔的地区东临墨西哥湾，向内陆连接新莱昂与圣路易斯波托西。

english: Tula belongs to the wider Arkansas country of the North American interior. Mountainous Ozark and Ouachita lands contrast here with the eastern lowlands along the Mississippi and Arkansas Delta.
simp_chinese: 图拉属于北美内陆的阿肯色地区。这里多山的欧扎克与沃希托地区，与东侧密西西比河沿岸及阿肯色三角洲的低地形成对照。

english: Tula stands on the Upa, a tributary of the Oka. A small medieval fortress on Ryazan’s frontier, it became a stronghold of Moscow’s Great Abatis Belt after its brick kremlin was built in 1514–1521. Its later fame rests on armaments and samovars.
simp_chinese: 图拉位于奥卡河支流乌帕河畔。它起初是梁赞边境的一座中世纪小堡，1514至1521年砖砌克里姆林建成后，成为莫斯科大鹿砦防线的据点。后世则以军械与茶炊闻名。

english: Tulak belongs to the eastern Khorasan country associated with Herat. The regional centre grew in the fertile Hari River valley, where Silk Road connections linked West, Central, South and East Asia.
simp_chinese: 图拉克属于与赫拉特相关的东呼罗珊地区。地区中心在肥沃的哈里河谷发展，丝绸之路网络在此连接西亚、中亚、南亚与东亚。

english: Tulamba stands on the eastern Ravi bank in Punjab. Archaeological layers and coins record successive Hindu, Buddhist, Muslim and Sikh periods, revealing a long history beneath the present town.
simp_chinese: 图兰巴位于旁遮普拉维河东岸。考古地层与钱币记录着相继的印度教、佛教、穆斯林和锡克时期，显示出现代城镇之下漫长的历史。

english: Taiwan’s eastern coast faces the northwestern Pacific. Mountain ranges dominate the island’s eastern two-thirds, leaving the broadest plains to the west.
simp_chinese: 台湾东岸面向西北太平洋。山地占据岛屿东部约三分之二，较广阔平原则位于西侧。

english: The island waters near Bangka belong to the Indonesian maritime region between two great oceans. Sea trade connected this archipelago with neighbouring lands by the first millennium before the common era, before the rise of its later Hindu-Buddhist kingdoms.
simp_chinese: 邦加附近的岛屿水域属于两大洋之间的印度尼西亚海洋区域。至迟在公元前第一千纪，海上贸易已将群岛与周围地区相连，随后这里兴起了印度教佛教王国。

english: Tulare Lake once spread across California’s southern San Joaquin Valley. Diversion of tributaries in the nineteenth century dried much of a lake whose rich waters had supported Indigenous communities for millennia.
simp_chinese: 图莱里湖曾广布加利福尼亚南部圣华金谷。十九世纪支流改道使大片湖面干涸，此前丰饶水域已支撑原住民社群数千年。

english: Tulazi belongs to the Tumen valley of northeastern Asia. The river descends from Mount Paektu toward the Sea of Japan and runs for about 521 kilometres. Along much of its course it separates the northeastern Chinese uplands from northern Korea.
simp_chinese: 土拉子属于东北亚图们江河谷。图们江从白头山流向日本海，全长约521公里。河流大部分河段分隔中国东北山地与朝鲜北部。

english: Tulcea occupies a high site beside the Danube in northern Dobruja. Ancient Aegyssus guarded the river under Roman rule. Amphora finds reveal commercial activity, showing how a defended position also served exchange along the great river.
simp_chinese: 图尔恰占据北多布罗加多瑙河畔高处。古代埃吉苏斯在罗马治下守卫河流。双耳陶罐发现显示商业活动，说明设防位置也服务于大河沿线交换。

english: Tulemalu Lake spreads across the Kivalliq country of northern Canada. Its waters cover about 668 square kilometres at an elevation near 279 metres. The lake forms one of the large inland water bodies of present-day Nunavut.
simp_chinese: 图莱马卢湖铺展于加拿大北部基瓦里克地区，面积约668平方公里，海拔约279米。它是今天努纳武特的大型内陆水体之一。

english: Tulguur lies within the broader Ussuri region, whose principal river joins the Amur near Khabarovsk. Rain and melting snow feed this flood-prone waterway, while its basin extends across northeastern China and the Russian Far East.
simp_chinese: 图勒古尔位于广义的乌苏里地区，其主要河流在哈巴罗夫斯克附近汇入黑龙江。雨水与融雪补给这条易发洪水的河流，流域横跨中国东北与俄罗斯远东。

english: Tuliemao lies within the wider historical region of Manchuria. This northeastern Asian country is defined variously, with its broadest customary usage extending into the Amur basin and the Russian Far East.
simp_chinese: 图列毛位于广阔的满洲历史区域。对于这片东北亚土地的范围有不同界定，通常较广的用法延伸至黑龙江流域与俄罗斯远东。

english: Tulita stands where the Great Bear River joins the Mackenzie. Its Slavey name means where the waters meet, while the nineteenth-century trading post was known to fur traders as Fort Norman.
simp_chinese: 图利塔位于大熊河汇入麦肯齐河之处。斯拉维语名称意为水流交会地，而十九世纪贸易站在皮毛商人中称为诺曼堡。

english: Tullahoma was founded in 1852 as a railway work camp in Tennessee. Its name is commonly traced to a Choctaw expression meaning red rock, linking the later town with an Indigenous-derived place-name.
simp_chinese: 图拉霍马于1852年作为田纳西铁路工地营地建立。名称通常追溯至意为红色岩石的乔克托语表达，使后来的城镇保留了原住民来源的地名。

english: Tullamore lies in Ireland's central plain beside the Grand Canal. Its Irish name means great mound, while a whiskey distillery founded in 1829 became the source of its best-known export.
simp_chinese: 塔拉莫尔位于爱尔兰中央平原的大运河旁。爱尔兰语地名意为大土丘，1829年建立的威士忌酒厂则成为当地最著名出口产品的源头。

english: Tulle belongs to the historic Limousin country of France. The wider province occupies the western side of the Massif Central and takes its name from the Celtic Lemovices.
simp_chinese: 蒂勒属于法国历史上的利穆赞地区。这片省区位于中央高原西侧，名称源自凯尔特人的莱莫维斯部族。

english: Tulln stands on the southern bank of the Danube northwest of Vienna. Its surrounding basin reaches toward the Vienna Woods, linking the river town with Lower Austria’s inland country.
simp_chinese: 图尔恩坐落在维也纳西北的多瑙河南岸。周边盆地延伸向维也纳森林，将这座河畔城镇与下奥地利内陆联系起来。

english: Tulnici lies at the foot of Romania’s Vrancea Mountains and was recorded around 1466. Its modern commune includes Coza, Greșu and Lepșa as well as the namesake village.
simp_chinese: 图尔尼奇位于罗马尼亚弗兰恰山麓，约1466年已有记载。现代辖区除了同名村落，还包括科扎、格雷舒与莱普沙。

english: Tulor preserves an ancient village complex near San Pedro de Atacama. Circular mud walls and vaulted structures survive from occupation spanning late antiquity and the early second millennium.
simp_chinese: 图洛尔在圣佩德罗德阿塔卡马附近保存着古代村落群。圆形泥墙与拱顶结构留存下来，反映从古代晚期延续至第二个千年早期的人类居住。

english: Tulsa was settled by the Lochapoka band of the Creek people between 1828 and 1836. Formal municipal incorporation came in 1898, while much of the later city remained within Muscogee territory.
simp_chinese: 塔尔萨由克里克人的洛查波卡群体于1828年至1836年间定居。1898年正式建市，后来的城市大部仍位于马斯科吉领地之内。

english: Tulshun lies in the Puelmapu country east of the Andes. Across the wider region, Mapuche traditional lands extended over much of Patagonia and the Pampas. Argentine expansion during the Conquest of the Desert brought this territory under state control in 1878–1885.
simp_chinese: 图尔顺位于安第斯山以东的普埃尔马普地区。在更广阔区域内，马普切传统领地横跨巴塔哥尼亚与潘帕的大部分。阿根廷在1878至1885年“征服沙漠”战争中的扩张将其置于国家控制之下。

english: Tulsipur stands near the Nepal frontier on the Nakti and Siria rivers. Its Devi Patan temple attracts Hindu pilgrims from India and Nepal, especially during Maha Shivratri.
simp_chinese: 图尔西普尔位于尼泊尔边境附近的纳克蒂河与西里亚河畔。德维帕坦神庙吸引印度和尼泊尔的印度教朝圣者，尤以大湿婆节期间为盛。

english: Tulu Nama Dun belongs to the Oromo homeland of the Ethiopian interior. Medieval chronicles and Muslim geographers attest to Oromo communities in the highlands, interacting across frontiers with Christian Shewa and Muslim Harar.
simp_chinese: 图卢纳马敦属于埃塞俄比亚内陆的奥罗莫故土。中世纪编年史与穆斯林地理学家记载了高地上的奥罗莫社群，他们跨越边界与基督教绍阿和穆斯林哈勒尔互动。

english: Tulu Walal belongs to Oromia, the Ethiopian homeland of the Oromo people. This extensive region stretches between the Somali country in the east and the borderlands toward Kenya in the south.
simp_chinese: 图卢瓦拉尔属于埃塞俄比亚奥罗莫人的故土奥罗米亚。这片广大地区东接索马里地区，向南延伸至肯尼亚边境一带。

english: Tuluá lies in the heart of Colombia’s Cauca valley. Founded around 1741 by Juan de Lemos y Aguirre, it became a commercial centre known as the heart of the valley.
simp_chinese: 图卢阿位于哥伦比亚考卡河谷腹地。约1741年由胡安·德·莱莫斯·阿吉雷建立，后来发展为被称作“河谷之心”的商业中心。

english: Tulumni belongs to the southern Valley Yokuts world of California’s Central Valley. This language network includes varieties such as Telamni, Tachi and Yawelmani, reflecting the valley’s many related communities.
simp_chinese: 图卢姆尼属于加利福尼亚中央谷地的南部谷地约库茨文化地域。这一语言网络包括特拉姆尼、塔奇与雅韦尔马尼等变体，反映出河谷中众多相关社群。

english: Tulungagung grew from a smaller settlement within the older Ngrowo country of eastern Java. Local explanations connect its name with prayers for divine help against flooding.
simp_chinese: 图隆阿贡从爪哇东部旧恩格罗沃地区的一处较小聚落发展起来。当地解释将其名称与祈求神助抵御洪水联系在一起。

english: Tuma belongs to the wider Meshchyora country around Kasimov. This region’s early Finnic inhabitants were later joined and assimilated by Russians and Tatars, while Kasimov developed on the left bank of the Oka.
simp_chinese: 图马属于卡西莫夫周围广义的梅晓拉地区。早期芬兰语族居民后来与俄国人、鞑靼人共同生活并逐渐融合，卡西莫夫则在奥卡河左岸发展。

english: Tumaco is a Pacific port near Colombia’s border with Ecuador. Afro-descendant and Indigenous communities inhabit this hot coastal country, where parts of the modern city are built as stilt-house neighbourhoods.
simp_chinese: 图马科是哥伦比亚邻近厄瓜多尔边界的太平洋港口。非洲裔与原住民社群生活在这片炎热沿海地区，现代城区部分街区由高脚屋构成。

english: Tumaco Bay lies on Colombia’s hot Pacific coast near the Ecuadorian border. The adjacent port of Tumaco forms a coastal centre in Nariño, with communities predominantly of African descent alongside Indigenous residents. Stilt-house neighbourhoods are a distinctive part of the waterfront landscape.
simp_chinese: 图马科湾位于哥伦比亚炎热的太平洋海岸，靠近厄瓜多尔边界。邻近的图马科港是纳里尼奥地区的沿海中心，居民主要为非洲后裔，也有原住民社群。高脚屋街区是滨水地貌的独特组成部分。

english: Tuman belongs to the wider Qashliq country of western Siberia. The region’s historic centre, Qashliq, was a Siberian Tatar fortress beside the Irtysh and the sixteenth-century seat of the Sibir khans.
simp_chinese: 图曼湖属于西西伯利亚广义的卡什利克地区。地区历史中心卡什利克是额尔齐斯河旁的一座西伯利亚鞑靼堡垒，16世纪为西伯利亚诸汗驻地。

english: The Tumanskaya crosses the wetlands and tundra of the Anadyr Lowlands before reaching a lagoon on the Bering Sea. Sockeye salmon inhabit its waters. Belugas frequent the lagoon near the river's mouth.
simp_chinese: 图曼河穿过阿纳德尔低地湿地与苔原，最终汇入白令海岸的潟湖。河中生活着红鲑，白鲸常在河口附近潟湖活动。

english: Tumat lies beside the Chondon near its meeting with the Nuchcha in northern Sakha. Numerous lakes surround the village, including large Lake Orotko to the northeast.
simp_chinese: 图马特位于萨哈北部琼东河与努恰河汇流处附近。村庄周围湖泊众多，包括东北方较大的奥罗特科湖。

english: Tumatumari lies on the Potaro in Guyana’s interior. The settlement stands about fifteen kilometres upstream from the river’s junction with the Essequibo. Its position places it within the inland water network linking the two rivers.
simp_chinese: 图马图马里位于圭亚那内陆波塔罗河畔，距其汇入埃塞奎博河处上游约十五公里。位置使聚落属于连接两河的内陆水网。

english: Tumba belongs to the wider Luba cultural country of south-central Congo. Luba communities developed around the lakes and marshes of the Upemba Depression. Their society included skilled miners, smiths, potters and woodworkers, within a network of many clans and subgroups.
simp_chinese: 通巴属于刚果中南部卢巴文化的广大地域。卢巴社群在乌彭巴洼地的湖泊与沼泽周边发展，社会中有熟练矿工、铁匠、陶工与木工，并由众多氏族和支群组成。

english: Tumba Ikoko forms part of the Central African setting of the Congo basin. The wider region has a very long human past, with archaeological finds older than a hundred thousand years and later migrations of Bantu-speaking peoples.
simp_chinese: 通巴伊科科属于刚果盆地的中非环境。这片广大地区拥有极为悠久的人类历史，既有超过十万年的考古发现，也经历了后来的班图语人群迁徙。

english: Tumbalala belongs to the São Francisco river country of Brazil. The great river rises in the Canastra mountains, runs north through the interior and turns east toward the Atlantic. Known before colonization as Opara, its basin held many Indigenous languages and communities.
simp_chinese: 通巴拉拉属于巴西圣弗朗西斯科河地区。大河发源于卡纳斯特拉山，向北穿过内陆，再转向东流入大西洋。殖民之前称作奥帕拉，流域中生活着使用众多语言的原住民社群。

english: Tumbes belongs to Peru’s northern coastal Chala country. The wider coastal region supports mangroves and riverine vegetation, while northern areas include thorny tropical savanna trees quite different from the barren desert farther south.
simp_chinese: 通贝斯属于秘鲁北部查拉沿海地区。整个沿海区域拥有红树林与河岸植被，北部还生长带刺的热带稀树草原树种，与更南方的荒漠面貌颇为不同。

english: The Tumbuka homeland links the Luangwa valley and northern Lake Malawi. Numerous related groups speak dialects of Chitumbuka, including the Henga, Senga and Yombe. Their histories include small independent communities and later traditions of unity under the Nkhamanga kingdom.
simp_chinese: 通布卡人的故土连接卢安瓜谷与马拉维湖北部。多个相关族群使用奇通布卡语方言，包括亨加、森加与永贝。其历史既包括独立小社群，也包括后来在恩卡曼加王国下统一的传统。

english: Tumeremo developed from a Capuchin mission founded in 1788. Earlier Guayan and Kamaracoto inhabitants lived by hunting, fishing and agriculture near the Yuruari river country of eastern Venezuela.
simp_chinese: 图梅雷莫从1788年建立的嘉布遣会传教站发展起来。更早的圭亚纳人与卡马拉科托居民，在委内瑞拉东部尤鲁阿里河地区依靠狩猎、捕鱼和农业生活。

english: Tumkur lies in the Karnataka interior and is associated with the Siddaganga Matha monastery of the Lingayat tradition. The later city became an industrial centre near Bengaluru. Its religious institution preserves a different strand of local identity alongside modern manufacturing.
simp_chinese: 图姆库尔位于卡纳塔克内陆，与林伽派的悉达甘加修道院相连。较晚城市成为班加罗尔附近工业中心。宗教机构在现代制造业之外，延续着地方身份的另一层传统。

english: Tummana was an early capital of the Ratnapura Kalachuris. Temple ruins survive at the village, including the nationally protected Mahadev temple.
simp_chinese: 图姆马纳曾是拉特纳普拉卡拉丘里王朝的早期都城。村中留存多处寺庙遗迹，包括受国家保护的摩诃提婆寺。

english: Tump belongs to the Kech country of inland Balochistan. Balochi is the predominant language of this wider district, historically also called Turbat. Tump was long administered within Kech before becoming a separate district in 2026.
simp_chinese: 敦布属于俾路支斯坦内陆凯奇地域。俾路支语是广大地区的主要语言，该地区历史上也称图尔伯特。敦布长期由凯奇管理，2026年成为独立地区。

english: The Tumpi Coast lies beside the broader Humboldt Current system of the eastern Pacific. This cold current runs north along western South America before meeting warmer tropical waters off northern Peru, creating a productive transition in the ocean.
simp_chinese: 通皮海岸毗邻东太平洋更广阔的洪堡寒流系统。寒流沿南美西岸向北，在秘鲁北部外海与温暖热带海水相遇，形成富有生产力的海洋过渡地带。

english: Timbisha communities have lived around Death Valley and the southern Owens Valley since late prehistoric times. Their name means rock paint and recalls the red ochre found in the valley.
simp_chinese: 廷比沙社群自史前晚期便生活于死谷及欧文斯谷南部周围。族名意为岩石颜料，与谷中发现的红赭石相关。

english: Tumshukaiko belongs to the Huaylas highland country of the Andes. Across the wider system, elevated plateaus and valleys lie among parallel mountain ranges along South America’s western edge.
simp_chinese: 图姆舒凯科属于安第斯的瓦伊拉斯高地地区。在更广阔的山系中，高原与谷地分布于南美西缘的平行山脉之间。

english: Tumul belongs to the wider continental coast of the Sea of Okhotsk. That coast is cut into numerous headlands, peninsulas and bays, while archaeological traces around the sea record ancient Koryak and Yupik communities.
simp_chinese: 图穆尔处于鄂霍次克海大陆沿岸的广阔区域中。这片海岸分布着众多岬角、半岛与海湾，海域周边的考古遗迹记录了古代科里亚克人与尤皮克人的活动。

english: Tumzhdin belongs to the Tumnin region in the wider lower Amur world. The broad definition of historical Manchuria includes parts of the southern Russian Far East, an area associated with diverse peoples including Nivkh and Ulch communities.
simp_chinese: 托穆津属于广义黑龙江下游世界中的图姆宁地区。广义历史满洲包括俄罗斯远东南部的部分地区，与尼夫赫和乌尔奇等多样族群相关。

english: Tun belongs to the wider Quhistan country represented here by medieval Turshiz. Turshiz, also known as Turaythith, was a district and city corresponding to the modern Kashmar area of northeastern Iran.
simp_chinese: 通属于以中世纪图尔希兹为区域参照的广义库希斯坦地区。图尔希兹又称图赖西斯，是一处地区及城市，对应今天伊朗东北部的卡什马尔一带。

english: Tunanir belongs to the wider historical country around Mardin in northern Mesopotamia. Mardin, the regional centre, occupies a rocky hill near the Tigris and is known for its surviving Artuqid architecture.
simp_chinese: 图纳尼尔处于美索不达米亚北部马尔丁周边的广义历史区域。区域中心马尔丁占据底格里斯河附近的岩山，以留存的阿尔图格王朝建筑闻名。

english: Tunanmarca preserves an archaeological settlement in Peru’s Jauja country. Its stone buildings became a recognised national heritage site in 2000. A later commemorative coin depicts the architecture, bringing the highland ruins into a modern celebration of Peru’s past.
simp_chinese: 图南马尔卡保存着秘鲁豪哈地区的一处古聚落。石造建筑于2000年列为国家文化遗产。后来纪念币描绘其建筑，使高地遗迹进入对秘鲁历史的现代纪念。

english: The Tunari mountains rise in Bolivia’s Cochabamba region. Part of the surrounding landscape has been protected as Tunari National Park since 1992.
simp_chinese: 图纳里山地位于玻利维亚科恰班巴地区。周围部分景观自1992年起作为图纳里国家公园受到保护。

english: Tunas Grandes Lake belongs to the broad Pampas plains of Argentina. The wider grassland region has a temperate climate and fertile soils, and its landscape was substantially changed by the introduction of cattle, pigs and sheep.
simp_chinese: 图纳斯格兰德斯湖属于阿根廷广阔的潘帕平原。广义草原地区气候温和、土壤肥沃，牛、猪与绵羊的引入显著改变了其景观。

english: Peru’s coastal desert rises from the Pacific toward the foothills. Vegetation clusters near rivers and in mist-fed lomas among the otherwise dry hills.
simp_chinese: 秘鲁沿海沙漠从太平洋升向山麓。植被集中于河流附近及雾气滋养的洛马斯地带，其余丘陵则相当干燥。

english: Tungaru, the Gilbert Islands, is a chain of sixteen atolls and coral islands in the central Pacific. The islands form the easternmost part of Micronesia and extend in a roughly north–south line across the equator.
simp_chinese: 通加鲁即吉尔伯特群岛，是太平洋中部由十六座环礁和珊瑚岛组成的岛链。群岛构成密克罗尼西亚的最东部，大致南北排列，跨越赤道。

english: These waters lie among the Tungaru, or Gilbert, Islands. Sixteen atolls and coral islands form a roughly north–south chain across the equator at the eastern edge of Micronesia.
simp_chinese: 这片水域位于通加鲁，即吉尔伯特群岛之间。十六个环礁与珊瑚岛组成大致南北向的岛链，跨越赤道，位于密克罗尼西亚东缘。

english: These waters lie among the Gilbert Islands, the Tungaru chain of Micronesia. Its sixteen atolls and coral islands run roughly north to south, and their submarine foundations continue toward the Ratak chain of the Marshall Islands.
simp_chinese: 这片水域位于密克罗尼西亚的吉尔伯特群岛，亦即通加鲁岛链之间。十六座环礁与珊瑚岛大致呈南北走向，海底基底向马绍尔群岛的拉塔克岛链延伸。

english: These waters lie around the Tungaru, or Gilbert, island chain. Sixteen atolls and coral islands run roughly north to south, with the Equator crossing the group.
simp_chinese: 这片水域位于通加鲁，也称吉尔伯特岛链周围。十六座环礁和珊瑚岛大致南北排列，赤道从群岛中穿过。

english: These waters surround the Gilbert Islands, also known as Tungaru. The group consists of sixteen atolls and coral islands arranged roughly north to south across the equatorial Pacific.
simp_chinese: 这片海水环绕吉尔伯特群岛，群岛亦称通加鲁。这里的十六座环礁与珊瑚岛，在赤道太平洋大致呈南北向排列。

english: Tungaru comprises sixteen atolls and coral islands in the Pacific. The Gilbert chain runs roughly north to south and forms the main island group of Kiribati.
simp_chinese: 通加鲁由太平洋16座环礁与珊瑚岛组成。吉尔伯特岛链大体南北延伸，是基里巴斯的主要岛群。

english: Tungaru, or the Gilbert Islands, consists of sixteen atolls and coral islands in the Pacific. The chain runs roughly north to south across the equator and forms the easternmost part of Micronesia.
simp_chinese: 通加鲁又称吉尔伯特群岛，由太平洋中的十六座环礁和珊瑚岛组成。岛链大致南北排列，横跨赤道，构成密克罗尼西亚最东部。

english: Tungaru, also called the Gilbert Islands, forms a chain of sixteen atolls and coral islands. The islands run approximately north to south across the equator in eastern Micronesia.
simp_chinese: 通加鲁又称吉尔伯特群岛，由十六座环礁和珊瑚岛组成。这些岛屿在密克罗尼西亚东部大致呈南北排列，横跨赤道。

english: Tungaru is the Gilbert Islands chain, consisting of sixteen atolls and coral islands in the Pacific. The islands run approximately north to south across the equator, from Makin in the north to Arorae in the south.
simp_chinese: 通加鲁即吉尔伯特群岛，由太平洋上的十六座环礁与珊瑚岛组成。诸岛大致沿南北方向跨越赤道，北端是马金，南端为阿罗赖。

english: The Tungaru seas surround the Gilbert island chain in the equatorial Pacific. Its islands run roughly north to south, with Makin near the northern end and Arorae at the southern end.
simp_chinese: 通加鲁海域环绕赤道太平洋上的吉尔伯特岛链。各岛大致呈南北排列，北端附近为马金，南端为阿罗赖。

english: The waters of Tungaru surround the principal island group of Kiribati. Its coral islands and atolls stretch from Makin in the north to Arorae in the south, over a broad span of equatorial Pacific water.
simp_chinese: 通加鲁水域环绕着基里巴斯的主要岛群。其珊瑚岛与环礁从北部的马金延伸到南部的阿罗赖，跨越广阔的赤道太平洋海域。

english: The Tungaru offshore sea surrounds the Gilbert Islands, the main island group of Kiribati. Makin stands at the chain's northern end and Arorae at its southern end, separated by hundreds of nautical miles.
simp_chinese: 通加鲁外海环绕基里巴斯的主要岛群吉尔伯特群岛。马金位于岛链北端，阿罗赖位于南端，两者相隔数百海里。

english: Tungi belongs to the wider Swahili coastal world of East Africa. The regional name derives from the Arabic word for coasts, and its historical maritime setting includes Kilwa, the Comoros and Zanzibar.
simp_chinese: 通吉属于东非更广阔的斯瓦希里沿海世界。地区名称源于阿拉伯语的海岸一词，其历史海洋范围包括基尔瓦、科摩罗与桑给巴尔。

english: Tungkal lies in the Jambi country of eastern Sumatra. Kuala Tungkal is a port at the mouth of the Tungkal River, linking this river country with the sea.
simp_chinese: 通卡尔位于苏门答腊东部的占碑地区。瓜拉通卡尔是通卡尔河口的港口，将这一河流地区与海洋联系起来。

english: Tunguska belongs to the wider Yenisei country of central Siberia. The great river separates the West Siberian Plain from the Central Siberian Plateau before draining north into the Kara Sea.
simp_chinese: 通古斯卡小径属于西伯利亚中部更广阔的叶尼塞河地区。这条大河分隔西西伯利亚平原与中西伯利亚高原，随后向北注入喀拉海。

english: This Tunguska passage belongs to the wider Yenisei basin. The Yenisei is the central member of the great Siberian river systems flowing toward the Arctic Ocean. Its estuary opens between the Gyda and Taymyr peninsulas.
simp_chinese: 这条通古斯卡通道属于广义叶尼塞流域。叶尼塞河是流向北冰洋的西伯利亚大河系统中的中间一条。其河口位于格达半岛与泰梅尔半岛之间。

english: This Tunguska passage crosses the Uchami part of the Yenisei country. The broader Yenisei river system drains much of central Siberia toward the Arctic, with the Angara and the two great Tunguska rivers among its tributaries.
simp_chinese: 这条通古斯卡通道穿过叶尼塞地区的乌恰米一带。更广阔的叶尼塞水系把西伯利亚中部大片土地的河水汇向北冰洋，其支流包括安加拉河及两条大通古斯卡河。

english: This Tunguska route belongs to the Yenisei drainage country. The larger river system gathers waters from central Siberia, including the Lake Baikal basin, and forms the greatest river drainage into the Arctic Ocean.
simp_chinese: 这条通古斯卡小径属于叶尼塞水系地区。更大的河流系统汇集中西伯利亚包括贝加尔湖流域在内的水流，构成流入北冰洋的最大河流水系。

english: This route passes through the broader Lower Tunguska country of Siberia. The river flows along the western edge of the Lena Plateau before joining the Yenisei at Turukhansk, and remains ice-free only from about mid-June to early October.
simp_chinese: 这条通道穿过西伯利亚更广阔的下通古斯卡地区。下通古斯卡河沿勒拿高原西缘流淌，在图鲁汉斯克汇入叶尼塞河，大致仅从六月中旬至十月上旬处于无冰期。
